-Manage document control processes and maintain organized filing systems for all technical materials.

-Proactively identify documentation gaps and recommend improvements to processes and templates.



Qualifications:

-Minimum 10 years of hands-on experience in technical writing within a manufacturing, industrial, or engineering environment.

-Demonstrated ability to write highly accurate technical documentation without dependence on AI writing tools.

-Exceptional written English with outstanding grammar, spelling, and editing skills.

-Advanced proficiency in Adobe InDesign with proven ability to work with templates and maintain design consistency.

-Strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Acrobat).

-High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and OneDrive.

-Ability to understand complex technical concepts and communicate them clearly to diverse audiences.

-Outstanding attention to detail with commitment to producing error-free work.

-Excellent organizational and time management skills with ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

-Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams across departments.

-Highly organized and methodical approach to work and documentation management.

-Natural curiosity and willingness to learn complex technical products.

title: Portfolio Operations & Data Engineer
description:
We are seeking a Portfolio Operations & Data Engineer to support a growing luxury retail organization by combining technical expertise in business intelligence with responsibility for portfolio operations coordination. This unique hybrid role exists to automate reporting, improve operational visibility, reduce manual administrative work, and ensure facilities coordination, lease administration, and vendor management operate efficiently across multiple retail locations.



The ideal candidate will have 5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, or Data Analytics with advanced Power BI and SQL expertise, combined with comfort managing operational responsibilities across facilities, vendor relationships, and lease administration. You will serve as both a technical problem solver and an operational partner—building automated reporting solutions that replace manual processes while ensuring operational records remain organized, vendors remain accountable, and facilities requests are resolved efficiently. This is ideal for someone who enjoys solving operational challenges through technology while remaining connected to day-to-day business needs.



Job Responsibilities:



-Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards for Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership.

-Build automated reporting processes using Power Query, SQL, APIs, and spreadsheet integrations.

-Design and maintain ETL workflows that consolidate data from multiple business systems.

-Create scalable reporting solutions that eliminate manual reporting processes.

-Validate, clean, and transform operational data to ensure reporting accuracy.

-Maintain reporting documentation and data dictionaries.

-Support business stakeholders with ad hoc reporting and operational analytics.

-Coordinate facilities maintenance requests across multiple retail locations.

-Track maintenance work orders from initiation through completion.

-Maintain relationships with contractors, landlords, and third-party vendors.

-Source vendor quotations and coordinate Requests for Proposal (RFPs).

-Maintain accurate lease documentation and support lease administration activities.

-Manage operational records within MRI ProLease or similar property management systems.

-Coordinate documentation required for lease accounting and operational compliance.

-Identify opportunities to automate manual operational workflows.

-Partner with Operations and Finance leadership to support continuous improvement initiatives.

-Develop Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for reporting and operational processes.

-Improve reporting accuracy and operational visibility across departments.

-Recommend technology enhancements that improve efficiency and scalability.

-Ensure leadership has access to accurate, real-time operational dashboards.

-Ensure facilities requests are tracked and resolved efficiently.

-Keep lease documentation accurate, organized, and audit-ready.

-Proactively manage vendor communications.

-Make operational reporting more scalable and require minimal manual intervention.

-Provide greater visibility into operational performance for business stakeholders.



Qualifications:



-Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, or Data Analytics.

-Demonstrated experience developing Power BI dashboards for business users.

-Proven ability to build API integrations and automated reporting solutions.

-Strong experience working with SQL and data transformation tools.

-Advanced Power BI, SQL, Power Query, and REST APIs proficiency.

-Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and data modeling expertise.

-Experience building ETL processes and reporting automation solutions.

-Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

-Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.

-Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

-Able to manage multiple priorities across technical and operational responsibilities.

-Comfortable communicating with Operations, Finance, vendors, and leadership teams.

-Self-directed with excellent follow-through and accountability.

-Process-driven with continuous improvement mindset.

-Strong communicator capable of translating technical information into business insights.

-Proactive, dependable, and capable of working independently in a remote environment.

-Exposure to retail operations, facilities, or property management is strongly preferred.

-Microsoft Fabric experience is preferred.

-Azure Data Services experience is preferred.

-Power Automate experience is preferred.

-Python experience is preferred.

-MRI ProLease experience is preferred.

-Lease Administration experience is preferred.

-Property Management exposure is preferred.



Requirements:



-Updated Resume/CV.

-Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

-Reliable internet connection and personal computer.

-UPS/battery backup to ensure continuity during power interruptions.



Benefits:



-Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

-WFH set-up.

-Opportunities for career advancement.

-HMO coverage for employee and immediate family members.

title: Freelance Video Editor — Per-Project Work, No Time Tracking
description:
OVERVIEW:

Excellent Media is building out our Approved Vendors list — a bench of freelance video editors who take on commercial and social media editing projects alongside our retained team.

This is not a full-time job and it is not a monthly salary position. You are paid a flat, agreed amount per project. You see the pay and the estimated hours before you take anything, and you d
 whether you want it. If you don't want a project, you don't take it. There is no penalty for passing.

We are looking to add 3–4 editors to the list over the next two weeks.



HOW IT WORKS:

Projects are
ed out to the vendor list as they come in, with the pay amount and estimated hours listed up front.

If you want a project, you claim it by replying to the
. First reply gets the project.

You complete the edit, submit it for internal review, and we handle the client.

You invoice twice a month and are paid on fixed dates.

We do not guarantee a minimum number of projects, and available volume varies from week to week depending on our client load. Alongside client work, we run a baseline flow of internal marketing projects, so there are projects available every week — but busy weeks and quiet weeks are both normal, and we can't promise there will always be enough for everyone.

This position works best as supplemental income for an editor who already has other work, or who is between clients and wants steady access to projects without a fixed commitment.



WHAT WE PROVIDE:

No time tracking. No screenshots. No monitoring software. You are paid per project, not per hour.

Fixed payment dates. Invoices are submitted twice monthly and paid on schedule, every time.

Paid test projects. We do not ask editors to work for free. Our application process includes one short unpaid written sample assignment, followed by two rounds of paid test projects — all paid at the standard program rate — before you are added to the list.

Premiere Pro or CapCut is fine. You only need one of them. Free CapCut is acceptable.

Licensed music and stock assets provided. You request what you want and we license it through our company account.

Clear written project briefs, a written revision process, and a full Operations Manual so you always know what's expected.

Work on your own schedule, from wherever you want.



REQUIREMENTS:

Demonstrated commercial or social media video editing experience — we need to see your work.

Access to Premiere Pro or CapCut.

Written English strong enough to work from written briefs and revision notes.

A reliable computer capable of handling 4K source footage, and a reliable internet connection.

Ability to hit deadlines without being chased.



RATE:

Projects are paid a flat rate based on the scope of the project, with the pay and estimated hours stated on every offer before you d
 whether to take it. Most offers fall in the $10–15 range. Editors working at a normal pace earn the equivalent of roughly $3–5 per hour; our most efficient editors consistently land in the $4–6 range.



ABOUT US:

Excellent Media is a digital marketing agency serving YouTube creators, small businesses, and marketing teams. We've been in business over five years and run a retained editing team alongside this vendor program.



HOW TO RESPOND:

Reply to this job posting through OnlineJobs.ph with the word "watermelon" in the headline of your response. Why? It lets us see who is actually reading.

In your message, please include:

A link to your portfolio or demo reel. This is required. Applications without one will not be reviewed.

A link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile.

2–3 sentences on why this kind of per-project work fits what you're looking for right now. Please do not write more than that.



Thank you,

Joseph Woolwine

Post Production Supervisor, Excellent Media

title: Patient Coordinator - UK Surgical Clinic (UK Hours: 4PM–11PM Manila Time)
description:
IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word EYELID so we know you read this post. Applications without it are deleted.



We are the Eyelid Wellness Group, a private eyelid surgery clinic in the UK led by a Professor of oculoplastic surgery.



We are hiring a full-time Patient Coordinator to be the main point of contact for our patients: answering calls, booking consultations, managing the surgeon's diary, chasing consent confirmations and payments, and making post-operative check-in calls.



We are not looking for a freelancer to pass through. We are looking for a long-term partner in the business: someone who grows with us, knows our patients, and becomes the person the whole team relies on. In return you get full training over 4-5 paid weeks (with a training manual, scripts and templates for every situation), ongoing support, and a UK doctor on the team who you can go to directly with any problem or question. You will never be asked to answer medical questions yourself, and you will never be left out of your depth: anything clinical goes straight to the doctors, and anything you are unsure about, you ask. We would always rather you ask twice than guess once.



WORKING HOURS (fixed, non-negotiable):

- Monday to Friday: 4:00 PM to 11:00 PM Philippine time (9:00 AM to 4:00 PM UK time; one hour later November to March)

- Saturday: 2 hours 5:00PM to 7:00PM Philippine time (10:00 AM to 12:00 PM UK time; one hour later November to March)

- Sunday: 30 minutes to do patient check in calls to see if they are ok, only on weeks when surgery was performed the day before (on the Saturday) 6:00PM to 6:30PM Philippine time (11:00 AM to 11:30 AM UK time; one hour later November to March)



- Total about 35 hours/week. You must be available for every hour of this schedule.

- You follow the UK calendar, not the Philippine one. You work on Philippine public holidays; you have UK bank holidays off. Planned leave requires at least 2 weeks' written notice and agreement in advance.



REQUIREMENTS:

- Excellent spoken and written English. We expect crystal clear pronunciation. You will speak with UK patients all day, including people recovering from surgery. Your English will be assessed live on a video call. Your accent must be clear and easy for UK patients to understand; candidates whose videos show clear, confident spoken English in a style UK patients will easily follow will be preferred.

- Your own laptop (not shared), headset, and a private, quiet room. Patient calls are confidential medical conversations and must not be overheard.

- Stable internet of at least 25 Mbps down / 5 Mbps up, PLUS a working backup (mobile data/pocket wifi) and a plan for power outages. If your connection drops, our patients' calls go unanswered, so this is essential.

- At least 2 years in admin, customer service or coordination with direct customer contact. Medical, dental or clinic experience is a big advantage.

- You will need to be self-sufficient, organised and proactive, and able to see and sort out logistical and admin problems before they reach the clinical team or directors. We need someone who is 2 steps ahead.

- This is an exclusive full-time commitment during your working hours. Individuals only: no agencies, and no arrangement where someone else does any part of the work. The person we interview is the person who does the job, and identity is verified at contract and randomly on camera afterwards.

- You must be able to provide two references from previous employers or clients, with contact details we can actually call. These will be checked before any offer is confirmed.

- Independent contractor: you are responsible for your own taxes.



HOW WE WORK (read carefully before applying):

Working time is logged in time-tracking software with periodic screenshots during working hours. All business calls are recorded. Cameras are on for all Zoo
etings (which are also recorded and transcribed). You will have a daily catch-up with the director, and you must outline your agenda for the day at each one. There are clear KPIs (answer speed, response times, task completion) and a short end-of-day report.



Performance is reviewed weekly, especially in the first months. If KPIs are consistently not met after feedback and support, the contract will be ended. We are honest about this upfront: if you deliver, this is a stable, well-paid long-term role with a supportive team; if monitoring or KPIs are not for you, please do not apply.



OUR STANDARDS:

We are a high-end private surgical clinic. Our patients pay premium fees and expect flawless service, and we expect the same standard from our coordinator and all our staff. To be clear upfront about what ends the contract:



- Working for other clients during our paid hours. Your full attention belongs to our patients while you are on the clock. Time tracking makes this visible, so please do not apply if you run multiple jobs in the same hours.

- Dishonesty of any kind: covering up mistakes, padding hours, or claiming work was done when it was not. Mistakes are fine and expected, especially in training; hiding them is not. Tell us early and we will fix it together.

- Rudeness, coldness or impatience with patients or staff. Many of our callers are anxious or recovering from surgery. Warmth and patience are not optional extras in this role; they are the role.

- Repeated carelessness or incompetence: wrong details in bookings, unanswered calls, missed follow-ups, ignoring messages or instructions from our surgeons and doctors, ignoring the training materials. We give full training, clear scripts and honest feedback, and we expect you to apply them.



If you consistently deliver, you will be paid at the top of the market, treated with respect, and have a stable long-term role. We hold ourselves to the same standards we ask of you: clear instructions, prompt pay, and honest feedback.



PAY: $800-$950/month depending on experience, paid reliably every two weeks via PayPal or Wise (your choice). Paid training from day one. There is a 4-month probationary period; at the end of it we will reassess the wage based on your performance during probation. We want a long-term partner, and people who deliver will be duly rewarded.



TO APPLY, send all seven items:

title: Australian Bookkeeper & Finance Manager (Shopify & Xero Specialist)
description:
Hi,



We're Brew Methods, a Melbourne-based specialty coffee company looking for an experienced Finance Manager to build and manage our finance function from the ground up.



This role is only suitable for candidates with previous experience managing an Australian Shopify-based businesses. You must be comfortable working within Shopify, extracting and reconciling reports, understanding Shopify payouts, merchant fees, refunds, payment gateways, Shopify Capital, and ensuring GST is accurately recorded at the product level.



We currently do not have any accounting software in place. We're looking for someone to set up Xero from the ground up, integrate it with our Shopify store and business bank accounts, and then take ownership of our finance and bookkeeping processes on an ongoing basis.



Initially, this role will involve implementing Xero, connecting Shopify, our business bank accounts and payment providers, organising our financial records, establishing payroll and superannuation, and creating accurate financial systems from day one. Once everything is established, the role will become an ongoing position of approximately 8–12 hours per month, with opportunities to grow as the business expands.



Accuracy is extremely important to us. We sell a combination of GST-free and taxable products, so we require someone who can accurately reconcile Shopify sales at the product level—not simply record Shopify payouts into accounting software.



Key Responsibilities

Set up and configure Xero from the ground up.

Integrate Xero with Shopify, business bank accounts and payment providers.

Build and maintain accurate finance and bookkeeping processes.

Import and organise historical financial data where required.

Reconcile Shopify sales at the product level, ensuring GST-free and taxable products are recorded accurately.

Reconcile Shopify payouts, merchant fees, refunds, discounts, payment gateways and Shopify Capital repayments.

Perform weekly bookkeeping and bank reconciliations.

Manage Australian GST coding and prepare BAS working papers.

Set up and manage payroll for employees and directors.

Process PAYG withholding, superannuation and STP reporting.

Prepare financial reports for our Australian accountant.

Liaise directly with our accountant when required.

Organise receipts and invoices.

Provide simple monthly summaries showing profit, expenses, cash flow and GST obligations.

Continuously improve our finance systems and processes.



Requirements

Minimum 3 years' bookkeeping or finance experience.

Extensive experience working with Australian businesses.

Previous experience managing the finances of Australian Shopify-based businesses (essential).

Strong working knowledge of Shopify, including extracting financial reports, reconciling Shopify payouts, merchant fees, refunds, discounts, payment gateways and Shopify Capital.

Experience reconciling Shopify sales at the product level, ensuring GST-free and taxable products are accurately recorded.

Strong understanding of Australian GST, BAS preparation, PAYG withholding, superannuation and STP reporting.

Strong experience using Xero, including setting up new organisations from scratch.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail.

Able to explain financial matters in plain English.

Comfortable communicating directly with Australian accountants.



About Brew Methods



Brew Methods is a premium specialty coffee company based in Melbourne, Australia.



We roast and sell specialty coffee, brewing equipment and coffee subscriptions through our Shopify store, serving customers across Australia and around the world.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a long-term part of our business and take ownership of our finance function as we continue to grow.



To Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell us about your experience managing the finances of Australian Shopify-based businesses.

2. Describe the most similar Australian Shopify business you've worked with and your responsibilities.

3. Have you previously set up Xero for an Australian Shopify business? 

4. Have you managed Australian payroll, PAYG withholding, superannuation and STP reporting? Please describe your experience.

5. Have you prepared BAS working papers for an Australian accountant? 

6. Tell us about a client whose bookkeeping was similar to ours.

7. What hourly rate are you seeking?



Please include the words "Coffee is life" at the beginning of your application so we know you've read the entire job description.



Please do not apply unless you have experience with Shopify.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Senior Systems / Engagement Designer — Design the Progression & Reward Systems for Our Marketplace
description:
We're looking for a Systems / Engagement Designer to architect the progression, reward, and reputation systems that keep users coming back to our marketplace platform. This is a build-from-scratch role: you'll own the psychology, mechanics, economy, and feedback loops that drive real engagement — not just points and badges.



You'll design systems that motivate users to return regularly, complete onboarding, contribute and verify listings, build reputation and status, invite others, and ultimately drive marketplace activity. That means thinking in progression curves, reward schedules, social dynamics, and behavioral economics — and backing your decisions with data and engagement metrics.



We care far more about how you think about motivation and systems than about a specific job title. You'll likely be a strong fit if you've worked as any of the following: a Systems, Economy, Progression, or LiveOps Designer on mobile free-to-play or live-service games; a designer of MMO progression or economy systems; a Product or Growth Designer on a marketplace product (,duolingo Uber, DoorDash-style); or an engagement/retention designer in EdTech (think Duolingo). Self-taught folks from game studios are welcome. Familiarity with frameworks like Octalysis is a plus, but real experience shipping engagement systems matters most.



If you love turning products into experiences people genuinely want to return to, we'd love to hear from you. Tell us about an engagement or progression system you designed, the behavior you were trying to drive, and how it performed.

title: Staff Accountant
description:
We are seeking a Staff Accountant to support the financial operations of a dynamic private equity and investment firm across its management company and portfolio entities. This role is critical to maintaining accurate books and records, managing day-to-day accounting processes, supporting reporting cycles, and helping create the financial discipline and visibility needed in a fast-moving, operationally intensive investment environment.



The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of accounting experience in private equity, real estate, multi-entity environments, or high-growth operating businesses, with strong foundation in general ledger accounting, reconciliations, monthly close, and financial reporting. You must combine strong accounting fundamentals with a process-driven mindset, high attention to detail, and ownership mentality. This person should be comfortable working across multiple entities, supporting leadership with clear financial information, and helping build scalable financial processes as the firm and portfolio grow.



Job Responsibilities:

- Maintain accurate general ledger records for the management company and related entities.

- Record journal entries, accruals, prepaids, intercompany activity, and account reconciliations.

- Manage accounts payable and support accounts receivable tracking where applicable.

- Maintain monthly close schedules and ensure timely completion of recurring accounting tasks.

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and other balance sheet accounts.

- Ensure financial records are complete, organized, and audit-ready.

- Prepare monthly, quarterly, and ad hoc financial reports for leadership.

- Support variance analysis, budget-to-actual reporting, and cash flow tracking.

- Assist in consolidating financial information across entities or operating units where required.

- Partner with leadership to improve visibility into performance, spending, and operational drivers.

- Help maintain reporting packages that support data-driven decision-making.

- Assist with accounting across multiple legal entities, including management company, investment vehicles, and operating businesses as needed.

- Support transaction-related accounting, entity setup, and financial record integration.

- Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external accountants, tax advisors, or auditors.

- Maintain supporting schedules related to ownership, loans, allocations, and intercompany balances.

- Build and refine accounting workflows, close processes, and documentation standards.

- Help establish internal controls and approval processes for expenditures, reconciliations, and reporting.

- Recommend improvements to systems, templates, and financial processes to support scale.

- Contribute to a more institutional, process-oriented finance function.

- Assist with tax support, annual filings, 1099s, and audit requests in coordination with outside advisors.

- Maintain organized financial documentation and support compliance with internal policies.

- Ensure sensitive financial information is handled with discretion and integrity.



Qualifications:

- Minimum 5+ years of accounting experience in private equity, real estate, multi-entity environments, professional services, or high-growth operating businesses.

- Strong foundation in general ledger accounting, reconciliations, monthly close, and financial reporting.

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

- Strong proficiency in QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or similar accounting platforms.

- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets capability.

- Experience with expense management, bill pay, and document management tools.

- Comfort working in a data-driven, systems-oriented environment.

- High attention to detail and strong ownership mentality.

- Process-oriented and highly organized.

- Able to balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong judgment, discretion, and professional integrity.

- Comfortable operating in an entrepreneurial business that is building systems and scale.

- Experience handling multiple entities or business units is strongly preferred.

- CPA or progress toward CPA is preferred.

- Experience supporting private equity firms, search funds, family offices, or real estate investment platforms is preferred.

- Familiarity with portfolio company reporting, investor reporting support, or fund accounting concepts is preferred.

- Exposure to acquisition accounting or post-close integration support is preferred.

- Experience improving reporting automation, dashboards, or finance systems is preferred.



Requirements:

- Updated Resume/CV.

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Reliable internet connection and personal computer.

- UPS/battery backup to ensure continuity during power interruptions.



Benefits:

- Competitive salary with performance-based incentives.

- WFH set-up.

- Opportunities for career advancement.

- HMO coverage for employee and immediate family members.



Join our team now and be part of the top 1% talent in the Philippines!

title: TECHNICAL ONBOARDING MANAGER - $900 P/M + BONUSES (UP TO $1,400 P/M)
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- Salary: $900 per month

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

- Comfortable with Kajabi, Google Drive, and Zoom

- Willing to learn basic creator tools

- Reliable internet, strong camera, proper lighting, and quiet workspace

- Strong schedule discipline



WE ARE NOT A FIT IF



- You are low energy or unclear

- You get frustrated with confused clients

- You cannot explain tech in simple words

- You struggle to follow structured processes

- You cannot consistently maintain agreed working hours

- You have poor camera, lighting, or internet setup



HOW TO APPLY



Fill in the form: 
/to/nI8lIXV4



In the Name field write: “TOM” + Your First and Last Name



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: Virtual Assistant / Instagram DM Appointment Setter
description:
I am looking for a reliable, proactive and confident Virtual Assistant and DM Appointment Setter to join my team and help manage my Instagram DMs, nurture potential coaching clients and book qualified consultation calls directly into my calendar.

This role is about far more than replying to messages or ticking tasks off a list.

You will be responsible for building genuine connections, leading conversations, following up with potential clients and helping turn interest into booked calls. You must be comfortable taking initiative, keeping conversations moving and confidently asking someone to book a consultation when the time is right.



Please read the working-hours requirement carefully

My audience is spread across both the UK and Australia, so flexibility is essential.

You may be required to work nights/early mornings depending on your location.

The hours may change as my audience, campaigns and business needs evolve. This is not a role for someone who can only work within one rigid time slot each day.

My business is growing quickly, and I am looking for someone who wants to grow with it. You should be prepared for your responsibilities and working hours to increase over time as the role develops.



This role is NOT for you if:

- You require completely fixed working hours.

- You are not comfortable working UK evenings or potentially late-night hours.

- You are unable to adapt your availability as the business grows.

- Your written English is not excellent, natural and conversational.

- You do not have professional experience using Instagram.

- You have never booked consultation or sales calls into a calendar.

- You wait to be told what to do rather than taking initiative.

- You are only interested in completing basic tasks and logging off.?



This role IS for you if:

- You have proven experience managing Instagram DMs for an online business.

- You have experience nurturing leads and booking calls directly into a calendar.

- You are flexible, dependable and responsive.

- Your written English is excellent and sounds warm and natural.

- You are confident starting, leading and progressing conversations.

- You know how to build rapport without sounding scripted or overly sales-focused.

- You are organised and consistent with follow-ups.

- You enjoy working towards targets and tracking results.

- You have an interest in health, fitness or wellbeing.

- You are proactive and regularly spot opportunities for improvement.

- You are comfortable challenging me, sharing ideas and making suggestions that could help grow the business.



I do not want someone who simply sits back and waits for instructions.

I want someone who pays attention, thinks ahead and says, “I’ve noticed this could be working better. Here’s what I suggest.”



Your responsibilities may include:

- Managing and responding to Instagram DMs.

- Starting conversations with potential coaching clients.

- Building rapport and identifying suitable leads.

- Following up consistently with warm leads.

- Booking qualified consultation calls into my calendar.

- Keeping lead information organised and up to date.

- Tracking conversations, follow-ups and booked calls.

- Sharing feedback and suggesting ways to improve our DM and lead-generation process.



To apply, please
 
 and include:

- Why you believe you would be a great fit for this role.

- Your previous experience working with social media or online businesses.

- Specific examples of your experience booking consultation or sales calls.

- Your current availability and time zone.

- Confirmation that you can work UK evenings and night/early morning hours and you are willing to adjust working hours if necessary.

- The number of hours you are currently available each week.

- Your thoughts on my Instagram account: _elevatewithemma_ - please DO NOT message me on my instagram,
 only.

- One suggestion you would make to improve my current content.



I am looking for someone who is warm, professional, organised, ambitious and genuinely excited to become part of a growing online fitness brand.

This has the potential to become a larger and more involved role for the right person. I want to find someone who is looking for a long-term opportunity, takes pride in their work and is ready to grow alongside the business.

title: Level Up, Engr! Turn Your EE/ECE/ME Degree into a Global Trade Career with Korea
description:
[Recruitment Validity Period]

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.



[Company Introduction Materials]

- Company Introduction Video:

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

- Company
 Page:

www.
/dongyangeng



[Responsibilities]

- Check overseas buyer inquiries registered in the ERP program

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

- Confirm unclear product information or specifications with internal tea
mbers

- Manage quotation progress and related data in an organized manner



[Required Qualifications & Skills]

This position requires basic technical understanding because it handles information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products.

- Degree or background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related technical field

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

- Ability to carefully check documents, numbers, and technical information

- Basic Microsoft Excel and Word skills

- Ability to read English product inquiries and quotation documents and understand the basic contents

- Willingness to learn ERP programs and internal work systems

- Responsible attitude toward repetitive but important data entry tasks



[Preferred Experience]

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience handling quotations, purchase orders, invoices, or product lists

- Experience using ERP, inventory management, purchasing management, or quotation management systems

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

- Can handle repetitive data entry tasks responsibly

- Has an interest in global trade and technical products

- Wants to grow with a Korea-based global business team

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.



[Training & Work Support]

New employees are not expected to handle everything alone from the beginning.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Existing ERP input records accumulated over the past 4 years

- Educational tutorial videos to help understand the work

- A mentorship program to help new employees adapt quickly

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

- Additional explanations from a tea
mber who understands the current workflow



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

- This position is open to both entry-level or junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to adapt to our internal systems and operational standards.

- Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



[Compensation & Employment Terms]

1. Eligible Career Level

- This position is open to both entry-level/junior candidates and experienced candidates.

- Entry-level or junior candidates with little or no related work experience will receive structured training under a designated mentor to help them adapt to our internal systems, work process, and operational standards.



Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.



2. Payment Terms

- Payment Term: Monthly basis

- Probationary Period: 6 months



3. Salary Guideline for Entry-Level and Junior Candidates

- For entry-level candidates or candidates with limited related experience, the probationary salary will follow the company’s internal guideline below.

- Months 0–3: USD 280/month

- Months 4–6: USD 300/month

- Subject to satisfactory performance evaluation after the first 3 months.

The probationary period may be shortened if the employee demonstrates fast work adaptation and receives an excellent evaluation. This has occurred in multiple past cases.



4. Salary Guideline for Experienced Candidates

- Candidates with 3 or more years of relevant practical experience may apply as experienced candidates.

- For experienced candidates, the contracted monthly salary may be considered up to USD 450/month, depending on the candidate’s work experience, practical capability, technical understanding, communication skills, and overall fit for the position.

- Experienced candidates will also be subject to a 6-month probationary period. During the probationary period, salary will be paid according to the following structure.

- Months 0–3: 90% of the contracted monthly salary

- Months 4–6: 100% of the contracted monthly salary

- For example, if the final contracted monthly salary is set at USD 450/month, the employee will receive USD 405/month during Months 0–3 and USD 450/month during Months 4–6.

- The final contracted monthly salary will be determined after reviewing the candidate’s relevant experience, job understanding, work capability, sense of responsibility, communication skills, and overall fit with the company’s internal standards.



[After Regularization]

- Annual contract renewal is standard after regularization.

- Salary adjustments may be made based on performance, teamwork, and overall evaluation.

- If overall performance, including work capability, teamwork, reliability, and internal evaluations, is considered outstanding, - salary increases may be granted within a shorter period. This has occurred in multiple past cases.

- Exceptional performance may also lead to early promotions or salary increases prior to the annual review.



[Perks & Benefits]

1. Regular Employee Benefits

- 13th Month Salary provided

- 10 additional paid leave days upon regularization

2. Performance-Based Incentives

- Additional incentives may be provided during high-performance business periods or when performance is excellent.

- Incentives are reviewed based on work attitude, responsibility, consistency, and overall contribution.

3. Paid Holidays

- January 1st, New Year’s Day, and Christmas Day are paid holidays.

- This applies to both probationary and regular employees.

4. Long Service Incentive Program

- 1 Year Service: PHP 17,000

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

- 5 Year Service: PHP 28,000



[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form






Interview via google meet will be conducted after first screening and candidates will be notifed to their
s or

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.



If you have a background in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field, and you can handle documents and data carefully, you can successfully adapt to this role with DYE’s training and support.



As DYE plans to expand its global team with a focus on Filipino talent, this position offers the opportunity to grow into a larger role in the future.

title: Junior Credit Analyst | Australian Private Lending | Remote Philippines
description:
Archer Wealth

Location: Remote, Philippines

Employment: Full-time

Schedule: Monday to Friday, aligned with Sydney business hours

Salary: Competitive salary plus annual performance bonus

Build Your Credit Career with a Leading Australian Private Lender



Archer Wealth is a fast-growing Australian non-bank lender specialising in business-purpose property finance.



Since launching, we have originated more than AUD $700 million in loans and built a strong reputation for fast, commercial and responsible lending decisions.



We are now looking for a smart, highly organised Junior Credit Analyst based in the Philippines to support our Australian credit team.



This is an opportunity to develop practical experience in Australian property lending, credit assessment and private finance while working directly with an experienced Sydney-based team.



About the Role



As a Junior Credit Analyst, you will assist our credit team with reviewing and assessing commercial loan applications secured by Australian property.



You will help collect, analyse and verify financial information, identify risks and prepare clear credit submissions for senior approval.



Your responsibilities will include:



• Reviewing loan applications and supporting documents

• Analysing bank statements, financial statements and borrower information

• Reviewing property valuations, loan-to-value ratios and proposed loan structures

• Completing company, trust, property and borrower searches

• Checking loan applications against Archer Wealth’s lending policies

• Identifying missing information, credit risks and policy exceptions

• Preparing preliminary credit assessments and credit submissions

• Maintaining accurate borrower and loan records in our systems

• Following up outstanding documents and approval conditions

• Supporting settlements, loan variations and portfolio reviews

• Communicating professionally with the Australian credit, sales and operations teams

• Assisting with reporting, reconciliations and other credit administration tasks



You will receive training in Archer Wealth’s lending products, credit policies and assessment processes.



About You



You are analytical, careful and naturally curious. You enjoy working with numbers, investigating inconsistencies and making sure every detail is correct.



You take ownership of your work, communicate clearly and are comfortable asking questions when information does not make sense.



To succeed in this role, you should have:



• A bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Banking, Business or a related discipline

• At least 1 year of experience in banking, lending, credit analysis, loan processing, finance or accounting

• Strong numerical and financial analysis skills

• Excellent attention to detail

• Strong written and spoken English

• Good Microsoft Excel skills

• The ability to review large amounts of information accurately

• Strong organisation and time-management skills

• A reliable internet connection and suitable home working environment

• Availability to work during Australian business hours



Experience in Australian lending, mortgage processing, property finance, commercial lending or private credit would be highly regarded, but is not essential.



What We Offer



• Competitive salary plus annual performance bonus

• Full-time, long-term employment

• Remote work from anywhere in the Philippines

• Training in Australian commercial property lending and private credit

• Direct exposure to experienced Australian credit professionals

• Clear opportunities for career progression

• A collaborative, high-performance working environment

• The opportunity to contribute to one of Australia’s growing private lending businesses



 Why Join Archer Wealth?



This is not a basic data-entry or administrative position.



You will be trained to understand real lending transactions, assess financial information, identify credit risks and contribute to commercial lending decisions.



As your capability grows, so will your responsibilities and opportunities within the business.



If you are ambitious, commercially minded and serious about building a career in credit and finance, we would like to hear from you.



Apply now and take the next step in your credit career with Archer Wealth.

title: Virtual Operations Manager – Australian Cleaning Business
description:
FULL-TIME VIRTUAL OPERATIONS MANAGER

Australian Cleaning Business | Long-Term Role



The Great Cleansed Space (GCS) is looking for a warm, capable and emotionally steady Virtual Operations Manager to take genuine ownership of our daily operations.



This is not a basic task-taking VA position. We need someone who can understand the bigger picture, make sound decisions, confidently communicate with Australian clients and tea
mbers, and bring both compassion and accountability to difficult situations.



We are not looking for the cheapest applicant or a short-term freelancer. We want to find the right person, train them properly and build a trusted working relationship that lasts for years.



ABOUT GCS



The Great Cleansed Space is a locally owned residential cleaning business based in Rockhampton, Queensland, Australia.



We support more than 100 regular clients through a local team of cleaners. Our work is about more than cleaning—we often enter people’s lives during vulnerable, overwhelming or exhausting seasons. We aim to make clients feel supported rather than judged.



Our team is predominantly made up of women and mothers. We care deeply about treating people with compassion and flexibility, but we also need reliability, accountability and clear boundaries.



THE PURPOSE OF THE ROLE



You will eventually take ownership of almost every area of daily operations other than payroll and financial reconciliation.



The owner needs to step away from being at the centre of every booking, cancellation, client concern and team decision. Your role will be to ensure that clients, tea
mbers and important details remain well cared for while the owner steps back.



This role requires someone who takes responsibility for outcomes—not merely someone who completes assigned tasks.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Client communication and care:



* Respond to phone calls,
s,
 messages and 
 in the established GCS voice.

* Follow up estimates and onboard new clients.

* Manage cancellations, rescheduling, complaints and sensitive conversations.

* Investigate concerns fairly and communicate practical solutions.

* Check spam and all communication channels so important messages are not missed.



Scheduling and daily operations:



* Maintain accurate bookings and client records in ZenMaid.

* Manage cleaner sickness, availability changes and cancellations.

* Contact affected clients and coordinate replacements where possible.

* Keep ZenMaid and our Trello availability board aligned.

* Prevent double bookings, unrealistic travel times and scheduling conflicts.

* Identify gaps and risks before they become emergencies.



Team coordination and accountability:



* Act as the primary day-to-day contact for our cleaning team.

* Respond to sickness notifications, questions and availability changes.

* Show genuine empathy while considering the effect on clients, coworkers and the business.

* Communicate clear expectations around reliability, notice and professional conduct.

* Recognise recurring patterns and hold respectful but direct conversations.

* Support recruitment, onboarding and team recognition.



Growth, marketing and client relationships:



* Follow up suitable leads and help convert available hours into sustainable recurring bookings.

* Create and schedule
 and Instagram content in the GCS voice.

* Advertise available sessions in relevant local community groups.

* Nurture existing client relationships through thoughtful follow-ups, appreciation and review requests.

* Track which activities lead to suitable enquiries and bookings.



Systems and owner communication:



* Maintain templates, checklists, procedures and organised records.

* Identify recurring problems and develop ways to prevent them.

* Provide concise daily tracking notes covering important actions and unresolved matters.

* Escalate significant issues with the facts, available options and your recommendation.

* Communicate mistakes and bad news honestly and promptly.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



You are warm, emotionally intelligent and genuinely kind—but you are not a people-pleaser.



You can care about what someone is experiencing without becoming so emotionally involved that it prevents you from making the decision the situation requires. You understand that empathy and accountability are not opposites.



You remain calm when several problems happen at once. You identify what is urgent, what can wait and what information is missing. You investigate situations and make appropriate decisions rather than returning every small question to the owner.



You can support a cleaner experiencing a difficult family situation while still recognising the effect repeated cancellations have on clients. You can listen compassionately to a frustrated client while applying policies fairly.



You accept feedback without becoming defensive, disclose mistakes early and help prevent them from happening again.



ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS



* Excellent written and spoken English.

* Confidence making and receiving telephone calls with Australians.

* Experience coordinating people, clients, schedules or business operations.

* Strong customer-service experience, including complaints and sensitive conversations.

* Sound judgement, initiative, organisation and attention to detail.

* Ability to learn technology and move between several systems.

* Confidence creating social content and using—or learning—Canva.

* Reliable availability throughout the advertised working hours.

* A dependable computer for recruitment, training and the initial period.

* Fast primary internet, backup connectivity and a reasonable power-outage plan.

* A quiet and professional workspace suitable for confidential calls.

* No overlapping employment, freelance clients or other commitments during GCS working hours.



Experience with ZenMaid, Trello, Gmail, Google Workspace, Canva or Meta Business Suite is helpful but not essential. We care more about how you think, learn and handle responsibility.



WORKING HOURS



Monday to Friday, 6:00am–2:30pm Philippine time

Monday to Friday, 8:00am–4:30pm Queensland time



The schedule includes a 30-minute unpaid meal break and provides 40 paid hours each week.



Queensland does not observe daylight saving time, so the hours remain consistent throughout the year.



This is a live operational role, not a flexible freelance arrangement. You must be online, contactable and ready to begin work at the agreed time. You will not be expected to routinely monitor messages outside your working hours.



SALARY AND BENEFITS



* ?50,000–?80,000 PHP monthly base salary.

* Training and orientation begin at ?50,000 PHP per month.

* Guaranteed capability and salary review after eight weeks. Any increase will reflect demonstrated accuracy, judgement, learning and operational ownership.

* Philippine 13th-month pay in addition to the monthly base salary.

* Paid leave and public-holiday arrangements clearly documented.

* ?1,000 PHP weekly coffee allowance from your first week, with no receipts required.

* Lump-sum performance bonuses for agreed and measurable milestones.

* Dedicated GCS laptop and quality noise-cancelling headset following successful completion of the initial period.

* GCS-controlled phone system, so you will not use your personal number or pay for business calls.

* Structured paid training, professional growth and increasing decision-making authority.

* Predictable weekday hours and respect for your personal time.



Paid training is expected to begin in late September 2026. During your first month, you will receive approximately 40 hours of direct practical training with our current administrator, primarily through live screen sharing.



HOW TO APPLY



Applications must be submitted through our application form:




/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd0l9JP4I2lOVJZ5IX-My-49kE8Uq_2ASV6jnZK1cNt0-yK-Q/viewform



The application takes approximately 30–45 minutes and includes:



* Your résumé and OnlineJobs.ph profile.

* Questions about your experience, work setup and ongoing commitments.

* Three practical operational scenarios.

* An unedited voice or video introduction of no more than three minutes.



Please do not
, directly message or use OnlineJobs.ph messaging to submit your application. Applications will only be assessed when completed through the form.



AI USE DURING THE APPLICATION



AI can be a valuable workplace tool, and the successful applicant may use approved AI tools responsibly within GCS.



However, please do not use ChatGPT or another generative-AI tool to write, rewrite or substantially improve your application or scenario responses. We need to understand how you naturally communicate, reason and make decisions.



Ordinary spelling and grammar checking is completely acceptable.



Shortlisted applicants will discuss their answers and respond to similar unprepared scenarios during a live interview.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



Shortlisted applicants will attend a live interview and complete a short paid practical exercise involving scheduling, communication and prioritisation.



Finalists will participate in a values conversation, provide professional references and complete appropriate background checks before a paid initial period begins.



If you want a long-term role where you can be trusted, contribute ideas, grow with one business and combine genuine kindness with strong operational leadership, we would love to hear from you.

title: Right Hand to the CEO (Virtual, Part-Time Contractor)

Read this part first

We are not hiring an assistant. We are hiring a unicorn.



The person we want does not wait to be told. They see the thing that needs doing and they do it. They are so autonomous they can practically manage the person they work for. If you have ever been the one people say "I don't know what I'd do without them" about, keep reading. This is a role built on one word: LEADERSHIP.



You will lead the inbox. Lead the follow-up. Lead the one-off fires nobody trained you for. You will take ownership of a busy CEO's day so she can go be the CEO.



What you'll actually do

Manage two inboxes and a calendar. A lot of
 is simple triage: archive it, or route it to the right person on the team with a clean intro, then track it so the follow-up actually happens. There is an easy system for this and it will be taught to you. You will draft on the CEO's behalf: most as yourself with your own signature, high-priority ones in her voice for her to tweak and send.



Communicate through Slack. Log and track your work in ClickUp in the background, your tasks and hers, without needing anyone to manage ClickUp for you. Picture this: a photo of a business card and a voice note come through Slack about a meeting, and you turn it into a drafted follow-up
 without being asked twice.



Handle the one-off stuff that makes or breaks this role. Workers comp annual audits. Sales reports for liquor license renewals. Unemployment claims, or at least pulling the data from payroll so the team can close it out fast. These are not repeatable, trainable tasks. They are figure-it-out tasks. The right person is comfortable walking into something unfamiliar and getting it done.



Use your downtime well. The hours are part-time, and the work does not arrive in an evenly spaced stream. Some days are full. Some days are quiet. The person we keep long-term fills the quiet on their own: organizing the Google Drive, rebuilding SOPs, taking on the ongoing projects that never quite get done. The person we don't keep waits around for the next assignment.



What you need to bring

Real tech competence is non-negotiable: MS Office, PDFs, Acrobat, the basics done well. AI proficiency is a major plus. If you can help build and streamline systems with AI, you move to the top of the pile.



Confidence and autonomy above everything. This role rewards the person who figures it out, not the person who needs a script.



Canva and basic social media creation are a bonus. Not required, and the first thing we'd trade for stronger skills elsewhere. But if you've got it, tell us.



Three questions (answer all three to be considered)

Real answers only. This is where we find our unicorn.



1. Tell me about a time you were handed something you had never done before, with no instructions, and figured it out. What was it, and how did you get it across the finish line?



2. When your work slows down and no one is assigning you anything, what do you actually do? Give me a specific example.



3. You're working directly inside someone's inbox, drafting in their voice. How do you d
 what to handle yourself versus what to flag for them? Walk me through your judgment.



To apply

Put the word LEADERSHIP in your response so we know you read this all the way through. Then answer the three questions above.



The right person here isn't looking for a task list. They're looking to take something off someone's plate and own it. If that's you, we want to meet you.
