title: Senior Amazon FBA Product Research VA — Online Arbitrage
description:
# Senior Amazon FBA Product Research VA — Online Arbitrage



## About the Position



We are seeking an experienced, highly detail-oriented Amazon product research virtual assistant for a growing US-based ecommerce business.



Your primary responsibility will be finding **new, profitable, high-quality online arbitrage opportunities for Amazon FBA**.



This is not an entry-level position. Applicants must have at least **five years of direct Amazon product research and sourcing experience**, including recent hands-on experience with the US Amazon marketplace.



We are looking for someone who understands that a technically profitable spreadsheet entry is not necessarily a valid sourcing opportunity. Submitted leads must be accurately matched, currently profitable, available for purchase, and eligible to be sold on our Amazon account.



This is a flexible, results-driven position requiring a minimum commitment of **20 hours per week**. You may generally organize your own work schedule, but consistent output, accurate research, and dependable communication are required.



This position is intended to become a stable, long-term opportunity for the right person.



## Compensation



Starting compensation is **$100 per week** for a minimum commitment of 20 hours per week.



The first **30 days will serve as a paid trial and performance-evaluation period**.



Candidates who demonstrate strong, consistent performance will be eligible for a pay increase after the trial period. The first increase may raise compensation to **$125 per week**, with additional advancement possible as performance, results, and responsibilities grow.



A pay increase is not automatic. It will be based on demonstrated value, including:



* Lead quality and accuracy

* Consistency in meeting weekly requirements

* Percentage of leads that become viable purchases

* Exact product-match accuracy

* Account-eligibility accuracy

* Communication and responsiveness

* Ability to identify risks before submission

* Quality of replenishable-product candidates

* Ability to apply feedback without repeating mistakes

* Overall profitability and value generated for the business



We are comfortable paying more for exceptional work. Our priority is receiving results that justify the investment.



## Schedule and Availability



This is a flexible-schedule position requiring a minimum commitment of **20 hours per week**.



There is no required fixed daily shift, but the successful candidate must:



* Work consistently throughout the week

* Meet the required weekly lead output

* Provide at least one valid lead every one to two working days

* Never allow three working days to pass without submitting a valid lead or communicating a legitimate sourcing issue

* Respond to messages within one business day

* Communicate promptly when a time-sensitive opportunity requires review

* Provide regular progress updates

* Notify us in advance if work or lead output will be delayed

* Attend occasional check-ins or training sessions when necessary

* Maintain accurate records of completed work



Flexible scheduling does not mean inconsistent availability or irregular output.



Applicants must disclose their current work commitments and confirm that they can consistently dedicate at least 20 hours per week to this role.



## Primary Responsibilities



Your primary responsibility will be researching new Amazon FBA online arbitrage opportunities from reputable US retailers.



Responsibilities include:



* Finding profitable online arbitrage products

* Submitting a minimum of **four valid actionable leads per week**, with a target of five or more

* Confirming that every submitted ASIN is currently eligible to be sold on our Amazon account

* Verifying that the source product exactly matches the Amazon listing

* Reviewing Keepa history and current marketplace conditions

* Calculating realistic profit and ROI

* Evaluating sales demand, Buy Box activity, seller count, and competition

* Identifying listing, product, brand, and sourcing risks

* Looking for repeatable and replenishable opportunities

* Maintaining accurate and organized sourcing records

* Responding promptly to questions about submitted leads

* Preparing a brief weekly sourcing report



Amazon FBA will be the primary focus of the position.



Experience researching products for **Walmart Marketplace or eBay** is strongly preferred. Cross-platform sourcing may become part of the role after the Amazon workflow has been established.



## Required Weekly Output



The minimum weekly requirement is:



* **Four valid, high-quality, actionable Amazon FBA leads**

* A target of **five or more valid leads per week**

* At least one valid lead every one to two working days



A lead only counts when it satisfies all established sourcing requirements.



Submitting a large number of weak, restricted, mismatched, speculative, or unusable products will not be considered successful performance.



Lead quality is more important than filling a spreadsheet.



## Profitability Requirements



Every actionable lead must meet the following profitability standards:



* A minimum projected ROI of **30%**

* The minimum profit-per-unit requirement provided during onboarding

* Profitability based on the current source price

* Profitability based on a realistic current Amazon selling price

* Accurate Amazon referral and FBA fees

* Realistic inbound shipping and preparation costs

* Accurate sales-tax assumptions when applicable

* Accurate coupon, discount, cashback, and gift-card assumptions



The **30% ROI requirement is a minimum threshold, not the preferred target**.



Candidates should prioritize opportunities with enough profitability to withstand reasonable Buy Box fluctuations, unexpected expenses, and changes in marketplace conditions.



Products below 30% ROI must not be submitted as normal actionable leads unless specifically requested or approved in advance.



Discounts, coupons, cashback, rewards, or gift cards may only be included when they are:



* Currently available

* Verified to work

* Realistically obtainable

* Usable in the required purchase quantity

* Available without complicated or excessive stacking



A lead that only reaches 30% ROI through uncertain or unrealistic discount assumptions will not count.



## Definition of a Valid Actionable Lead



Every submitted lead must:



* Produce a minimum projected ROI of **30%**

* Meet the required minimum profit per unit

* Be profitable at the current purchase price

* Be currently available for purchase

* Be sourced from a legitimate retailer or supplier

* Exactly match the Amazon listing

* Have sufficient customer demand

* Have manageable competition

* Use realistic Amazon fees

* Include accurate inbound shipping, preparation, tax, discount, coupon, and cashback assumptions

* Be currently eligible for sale on our Amazon account

* Have no undisclosed issue that would make the product unsuitable

* Be freshly verified on the day it is submitted



All source pricing, availability, profitability calculations, marketplace conditions, and account eligibility must be checked on the same day the lead is submitted.



## Account Eligibility Requirement



Every submitted ASIN must be currently ungated and eligible for sale on our Amazon account.



The VA must verify:



* Brand eligibility

* Category eligibility

* ASIN-level eligibility

* Product-condition eligibility

* Any applicable approval or documentation requirements



Products requiring an approval application will not count as actionable leads.



A product should not be submitted merely because another seller or Amazon account is eligible to sell it.



If eligibility cannot be confirmed, the product must not be counted toward the weekly requirement.



## Exact Product-Matching Requirement



The VA must verify that the source product exactly matches the Amazon listing.



This includes confirming:



* UPC

* Model number

* Brand

* Product title

* Size

* Color

* Flavor or scent

* Quantity

* Pack count

* Variation

* Included accessories

* Product condition

* Bundle or multipack configuration



Products with uncertain, incomplete, or questionable matches must not be submitted as valid leads.



## Replenishable Product Requirement



The VA will be expected to actively search for products with replenishable potential.



The requirement is:



* A minimum of **one promising replenishable candidate every two weeks**

* A target of **two promising replenishable candidates every two weeks**



A replenishable candidate must:



* Meet all standard sourcing requirements

* Produce at least 30% projected ROI

* Be profitable at the current source price

* Be eligible for sale on our account

* Show consistent customer demand

* Have reasonably stable source availability

* Have a realistic chance of being purchased repeatedly

* Maintain acceptable profit and ROI

* Avoid dependence on unusually temporary or speculative pricing



Replenishable candidates are separate from the regular weekly lead requirement. They cannot replace the minimum four actionable leads per week.



A product will initially be classified as a replen candidate. It will only become a validated replen after it has been purchased, sold successfully, and reordered profitably.



## Leads That Will Not Count



The following will not count toward performance requirements:



* Products producing less than **30% projected ROI**

* Products that only reach 30% ROI through uncertain, expired, unavailable, or unrealistic discounts

* Products requiring brand, category, or ASIN approval

* Products that are only profitable after a possible future source-price drop

* Speculative or watchlist opportunities

* Incorrect source-to-Amazon product matches

* Products with incorrect pack counts, quantities, sizes, colors, or variations

* Products using inaccurate Amazon fees

* Products using unrealistic inbound shipping, preparation, or tax assumptions

* Products requiring excessive or complicated gift-card stacking

* Products depending on uncertain cashback, rewards, or discounts

* Products with weak or misleading sales history

* Out-of-stock products

* Previously rejected products resubmitted without a meaningful change

* Duplicate ASINs

* Multiple source links for the same underlying opportunity presented as separate leads

* Minor variations of an already submitted product unless specifically requested

* Recycled leads previously submitted to another client

* Publicly circulated leads

* Leads simultaneously shared with multiple clients



All leads must be researched specifically for our business.



## Risk Awareness



The successful candidate must be able to identify and clearly communicate concerns involving:



* Amazon selling on the listing

* Brand-owner dominance

* Sudden seller-count increases

* Unstable Buy Box pricing

* Intellectual-property complaints

* Brand or listing risk

* Restricted products

* Hazmat classifications

* Meltable inventory

* Expiration-date requirements

* Seasonal demand

* Variation mismatches

* Multipack and bundle discrepancies

* Oversized products

* High shipping or preparation costs

* Retailer purchase limits

* High customer-return risk

* Suppressed or unstable listings

* Weak sales history

* Price drops after seller entry

* Offers that only become profitable through complicated discount strategies



You will not be responsible for making the final purchase decision. However, you will be responsible for recognizing and disclosing material risks before a product is purchased.



## Tools



Experience with the following tools is strongly preferred:



* Keepa

* SellerAmp SAS

* RevSeller

* Amazon Seller Central

* Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel



Access to **Keepa, SellerAmp SAS, and RevSeller can be provided** when required.



All tools, accounts, business information, and login credentials must be used only for assigned work. Access may not be shared with any other person.



## Weekly Reporting



The VA will provide a brief weekly report containing:



* Total hours worked

* Number of valid actionable leads submitted

* Number of rejected or disqualified opportunities researched

* Replenishable candidates submitted

* Leads awaiting clarification

* Major sourcing challenges encountered

* Any criteria or account restrictions affecting lead production

* Priorities for the following week



The report does not need to be lengthy, but it must be accurate and submitted consistently.



## Minimum Experience Requirement



Applicants must have at least **five years of hands-on Amazon product research and sourcing experience**.



This must include recent product-research experience for the **US Amazon marketplace within the past 12 months**.



Relevant experience should include:



* Amazon FBA online arbitrage

* Keepa analysis

* SellerAmp SAS, RevSeller, or comparable sourcing tools

* Exact source-to-ASIN matching

* Amazon fee calculations

* Profit and ROI analysis

* Sales-rank and pricing-history evaluation

* Buy Box analysis

* Seller-competition evaluation

* Account eligibility and restriction checks

* Risk identification

* Replenishable-product research

* Researching US retailers



Five years of general virtual-assistant experience without substantial Amazon sourcing experience will not satisfy this requirement.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is:



* Highly experienced

* Extremely detail-oriented

* Honest about uncertainty

* Consistent and dependable

* Comfortable working independently

* Focused on quality rather than quantity

* Able to explain the reasoning behind a lead

* Skilled at recognizing risk

* Willing to follow specific sourcing criteria

* Receptive to feedback

* Able to improve without repeating mistakes

* Proactive without submitting speculative opportunities

* Interested in a long-term working relationship

* Respectful of client confidentiality

* Able to communicate clearly in written English



## Performance Evaluation



Performance will be evaluated based on:



* Providing at least one valid lead every one to two working days

* Never allowing three working days to pass without a valid lead or legitimate communication

* Consistently meeting the weekly requirement of four valid leads

* Working toward the target of five or more valid leads per week

* Percentage of submitted leads that meet or exceed the **30% minimum ROI requirement**

* Accuracy of profit and ROI calculations

* Accuracy of Amazon fee, shipping, tax, and preparation-cost assumptions

* Percentage of submitted leads that become viable purchases

* Exact product-match accuracy

* Account-eligibility accuracy

* Keepa and marketplace-analysis quality

* Risk identification

* Communication and responsiveness

* Replenishable-product performance

* Accuracy of weekly reporting

* Ability to follow instructions

* Ability to apply feedback without repeating mistakes

* Overall value generated for the business



Submitting leads that appear profitable but cannot actually be purchased, sold, or profitably fulfilled will not be considered successful performance.



## Paid Sourcing Assessment



Finalists will be required to complete a short **paid sourcing assessment** before an ongoing offer is made.



The assessment may include:



* Finding Amazon FBA online arbitrage opportunities

* Verifying exact source-to-ASIN matches

* Confirming account eligibility

* Reviewing Keepa history

* Calculating profit and ROI

* Confirming that submitted products produce at least 30% projected ROI

* Evaluating demand and competition

* Identifying product and listing risks

* Explaining why each product should or should not be purchased



All finalists will be evaluated using the same general standards.



Failure to follow the stated ROI, account-eligibility, or matching requirements during the assessment may result in immediate disqualification.



Strong performance on the assessment may lead to the 30-day paid trial.



## Confidentiality and Security



The successful candidate may be asked to sign a confidentiality agreement.



All business information must remain private, including:



* Product leads

* Supplier and retailer information

* Sourcing criteria

* Account information

* Sales information

* Spreadsheets

* Tool access

* Login credentials

* Business processes



Leads and account information may not be shared, reused, sold, or provided to another client.



## How to Apply



Your application must begin with the following exact sentence:



**I HAVE READ THE ENTIRE JOB POST AND UNDERSTAND ALL OF THE REQUIREMENTS.**



This sentence must be the first line of your response.



Applications that do not begin with this exact sentence will not be considered.



After the required opening sentence, please answer all of the following questions:



1. How many years of direct Amazon product-research experience do you have?

2. When did you most recently perform product research for the US Amazon marketplace?

3. What types of Amazon businesses and sourcing models have you supported?

4. How long have you used Keepa?

5. How long have you used SellerAmp SAS?

6. How long have you used RevSeller?

7. Describe your experience checking brand, category, and ASIN eligibility.

8. Describe your experience finding replenishable products.

9. Do you have experience sourcing for Walmart Marketplace or eBay?

10. How many hours per week are you currently committed to other clients or employers?

11. Can you consistently dedicate at least 20 hours per week to this role?

12. Describe one significant sourcing mistake you made and what you learned from it.

13. Explain how you confirm that a source product exactly matches an Amazon listing.

14. Explain how you determine whether an Amazon product is a strong, actionable sourcing opportunity.

15. Explain how you calculate ROI and which costs you include in your calculation.

16. Explain how you evaluate Amazon’s presence, seller competition, and Buy Box stability.

17. Are you currently performing product research for other Amazon sellers?

18. Would any of those sellers use sourcing criteria similar to ours?

19. Are you willing to complete a short paid sourcing assessment?

20. Are you comfortable with a starting rate of $100 per week during the 30-day trial?

21. Please provide a redacted example of a sourcing spreadsheet or product-research report you personally completed.



You may remove or hide confidential ASINs, source links, client names, and pricing from the sample. We are primarily evaluating your research process, organization, and level of detail.



Finalists may also be asked to provide a professional reference from a previous Amazon client or supervisor.



We are looking for a seasoned researcher who can consistently identify accurate, purchasable, and profitable opportunities—not someone who simply fills a spreadsheet with products that might work.

title: Medical Biller
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented and experienced Medical Biller to join our growing healthcare support team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with medical billing, insurance claims processing, payment posting, and accounts receivable management. This role is responsible for ensuring timely and accurate claim submission, resolving claim denials, and maintaining compliance with healthcare billing regulations while maximizing reimbursement.



Key Responsibilities

~ Prepare, review, and submit electronic and paper insurance claims accurately and promptly.

~ Verify patient insurance eligibility, benefits, and coverage prior to claim submission.

~ Review medical documentation and assign appropriate CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes when applicable.

~ Monitor claim status, identify billing issues, and resolve rejected or denied claims.

~ Follow up with insurance companies regarding unpaid or delayed claims.

~ Post insurance and patient payments accurately into the billing system.

~ Reconcile accounts and maintain accurate patient billing records.

~ Process patient statements and assist with billing inquiries.

~ Coordinate with providers, coders, and administrative staff to ensure accurate documentation.

~ Maintain compliance with HIPAA regulations and payer-specific billing requirements.

~ Prepare aging reports and assist with accounts receivable collection efforts.

~ Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy and reimbursement processes.



Required Qualifications

~ High school diploma or equivalent; Associate's degree in Healthcare Administration or a related field is preferred.

~ Minimum of 2 years of medical billing experience in a physician practice, clinic, hospital, or medical billing company.

~ Strong knowledge of medical billing processes and insurance claim submission.

~ Experience working with commercial insurance, Medicare, Medicaid, and private payers.

~ Familiarity with CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS coding systems.

~ Experience using Electronic Medical Records (EMR) and medical billing software.

~ Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

~ Excellent communication and customer service abilities.

~ High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.



Preferred Qualifications

~ Certified Professional Biller (CPB) certification is an advantage.

~ Experience with denial management and appeals.

~ Knowledge of medical terminology and healthcare reimbursement regulations.

~ Experience with revenue cycle management (RCM).

~ Familiarity with Kareo, AdvancedMD, Athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, DrChrono, or similar practice management systems.

~ Experience working remotely in a healthcare support environment.



Compensation & Benefits

~ Competitive salary based on experience.

~ Performance-based incentives (where applicable).

~ Health, dental, and vision insurance.

~ Paid time off and company holidays.

~ Professional development and training opportunities.

~ Remote or hybrid work opportunities (depending on business needs).



Skills



Medical Billing, Insurance Verification, Medical Claims Processing, Electronic Claims Submission, Accounts Receivable (AR), Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Payment Posting, Claims Follow-Up, Denial Management, Appeals Processing, CPT Coding, ICD-10 Coding, HCPCS Coding, Medical Terminology, Healthcare Reimbursement, Medicare, Medicaid, Commercial Insurance, Patient Billing, Collections, Electronic Medical Records (EMR), Electronic Health Records (EHR), HIPAA Compliance, Medical Documentation Review, Charge Entry, Coding Compliance, Practice Management Software, Kareo, Athenahealth, AdvancedMD, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, DrChrono, Microsoft Excel, Data Entry, Attention to Detail, Analytical Skills, Communication Skills, Time Management, Problem Solving, Customer Service, Organization.



Note for Candidates



We are seeking candidates with proven experience in medical billing and insurance claims management. Applicants should have a strong understanding of the revenue cycle, claim submission processes, insurance verification, payment posting, and denial resolution. Experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, commercial insurance providers, and EMR/EHR systems is highly preferred. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, capable of managing multiple priorities, and committed to maintaining accuracy and compliance while delivering excellent service in a fast-paced healthcare environment.

Applications are open until 3 business days from the date of the first recruitment announcement.



[Join DongYang Engineering and Build Global Business Together with Filipino Talent]

- DongYang Engineering (DYE) is an engineering-based global trading company located in Ulsan, Korea, with approximately 30 employees.

- DYE provides engineering and procurement services in the shipbuilding, offshore, plant, and wind power industries. We also support sourcing and quotation work for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products by connecting overseas buyers with domestic Korean suppliers.

- In addition, DYE works with global partners such as Schneider Electric and Emerson, supplying our partners’ materials and services to customers in Korea.

- Currently, DYE has a 3-member overseas sales team composed of Korean and Nepalese tea
mbers who are fluent in English. We provide a supportive working environment so that new employees can adapt quickly.

- DYE also plans to expand its overseas sales and global operations team with a focus on Filipino talent. Therefore, this position offers future opportunities to grow into a team leader or management role.



[About the Position]

- We are looking for an Electrical & Electronics Inquiry / Quotation ERP Data Assistant.(Entry~Experienced Level)

- This position is responsible for checking overseas buyer inquiries and supplier quotation information, then accurately entering and managing the data in our company’s ERP program.

- Since the products are related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical fields, the candidate should be able to understand and distinguish basic product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation terms.

- The ERP input method can be learned by referring to our existing work records accumulated over the past 4 years. Internal tea
mbers will also provide guidance when needed.

youtu.be/zCExthh9pzc?si=EkDCs7pqN6WylsWP

 Page:

www.

- Review product information related to electrical, electronic, and mechanical products

- Organize product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, supplier information, and quotation terms

- Enter organized information into each required field in the ERP system

- Check and reflect quotation materials received from domestic Korean suppliers

- Refer to existing ERP input records and enter data according to the company’s internal standards

mbers

- Basic understanding of electrical, electronic, or mechanical products

- Ability to distinguish product names, model numbers, specifications, quantities, unit prices, and quotation details

The following experience is not mandatory, but it will be helpful for adapting to the role.

- Experience in trading, export/import, purchasing, sourcing, or overseas sales support

- Experience communicating with suppliers or organizing supplier quotation data

- Experience reviewing product catalogs, spec sheets, manuals, or technical documents

- Experience with electrical/electronic components, industrial products, or machinery

- Experience organizing data using Excel



[Who We Are Looking For]

For this position, accurate understanding and careful organization are more important than fast typing.

This role is suitable for someone who:

- Handles documents and numbers accurately

- Can follow fixed formats and internal standards

- Does not guess unclear information and asks for confirmation when needed

- Can refer to previous examples and apply the same standards consistently

ERP input data may be used for quotation review, supplier communication, and future export decisions, so a responsible work attitude is very important.

DYE provides the following training and support:

- Guidance from internal tea
mbers

mber who understands the current workflow

Candidates with 3 or more years of practical experience in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronics engineering, trading, sourcing, quotation management, ERP data management, purchasing, export/import, or related fields may apply as experienced candidates.

- 3 Year Service: PHP 22,500

[How To Apply for the job]

Just Fill out 10 Simple Questions through Google Form

s or

This position plays an important role in accurately organizing overseas buyer inquiries and domestic supplier quotations for electrical, electronic, and mechanical products in the ERP system.

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Scaledforce

Scaledforce is a Canadian staffing company that helps growing Canadian businesses scale by hiring top-tier remote professionals. We focus on long-term placements, clear KPIs, and strong support so our tea
mbers can build stable, fulfilling and rewarding careers.



About the Client

You will be supporting the founder of a respected and growing law firm based in Vancouver, Canada. The firm serves business owners and incorporated professionals across British Columbia with proactive business and estate planning.



The brand is high-trust, calm, premium, educational, and founder-led. The firm focuses on long-term client relationships, a modern client experience, and helping clients create clarity and certainty across generations.



The founder leads overall strategy, positioning, messaging, and brand direction. He moves with intention and expects the same from everyone around him. This is a place where quality work, professionalism, and follow-through are non-negotiable.



Job Overview

We are looking for a full-time, remote Marketing Manager (Generalist) to own the execution and day-to-day management of marketing across
, webinars, referral partnerships, content, funnels, website coordination, and campaign operations.



This is not a strategic Head of Marketing role, and it is not an entry-level coordinator position. This is a mid-level operator role built for someone who thrives on turning strategy into consistent, high-quality output.



You will be the layer between the founder and a team of specialized contractors (webinar builder, web developer, paid ads team, and designer). You will coordinate their work, own the newsletter and LinkedIn presence, and ensure marketing campaigns ship consistently and professionally.



Copywriting ability is critical. You will write and edit marketing
s, LinkedIn posts, landing page copy, and campaign messaging on a daily basis. If you love crafting clear, persuasive, professional copy — this role will energize you.



Within 90 days, the founder should be confident that marketing execution moves forward without bottlenecks, communication is proactive, and campaigns are shipping on schedule



Work Schedule

•      Monday to Friday

•      9:00 AM – 5:00 PM PST (Pacific Standard Time)

•      Philippine Time: approximately 12:00 AM – 9:00 AM PHT

•      Full overlap with the founder’s working hours is required



Salary & Incentives

Base Salary: PHP 52,000 – 58,000 per month

Performance-based quarterly bonuses



Key Responsibilities

Campaign & Marketing Operations

•      Manage weekly marketing execution across all channels

•      Maintain campaign calendars, project timelines, and deliverable trackers

•      Coordinate deliverables across contractors and vendors (webinar builder, web developer, paid ads team, designer)

•      Build, document, and improve SOPs and internal marketing workflows

•      Track campaign execution and performance metrics — flag issues before they become problems

Copywriting & Content

•      Write and edit marketing
s, newsletters, LinkedIn posts, and landing page copy

•      Coordinate content publishing across LinkedIn,
, blog, and video channels

•      Organize founder-led content production and scheduling

•      Work with editors, designers, and contractors to maintain a consistent content cadence

•      Repurpose webinar and long-form content into evergreen marketing assets

 Marketing & CRM

•      Execute
 campaigns and newsletters end-to-end

•      Build nurture sequences, automations, and follow-up workflows

•      Manage list segmentation, scheduling, and deliverability

•      Monitor engagement metrics and optimize based on performance data

Webinar & Funnel Execution

•      Coordinate webinar promotion, logistics, and follow-up workflows

•      Build and optimize landing pages and registration funnels

•      Support webinar-to-consultation conversion systems

•      Continuously improve funnel performance based on data

Referral & Partner Marketing

•      Support referral partner communication and outreach campaigns

•      Coordinate joint marketing initiatives and follow-up systems

•      Maintain CRM tracking and relationship organization for partner channels

Website & Conversion Support

•      Coordinate WordPress updates, landing pages, and site improvements with developers and designers

•      Support ongoing website optimization and conversion rate improvements



Qualifications

Required:

•      At least 3+ years of practical marketing experience executing campaigns across multiple channels — not just strategy, but hands-on delivery

•      Strong copywriting ability — you will write
s, LinkedIn posts, landing page copy, and campaign messaging daily

•      Excellent written English communication — clear, concise, professional, and persuasive

•      Experience managing and coordinating contractors, vendors, or cross-functional collaborators

•      Strong project management and organizational skills — you keep multiple workstreams moving without dropping balls

•      High level of accountability and follow-through — you close loops and communicate proactively

•      Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) and willingness to incorporate them into daily work

•      Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment without constant oversight

•      Reliable internet connection and a dedicated, quiet workspace

•      Availability to work during North American Pacific Time business hours



Nice to Have:

•      Experience in legal / law firms or other professional services firms (accounting, consulting, etc)

•      Experience with HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Mailchimp, or similar
 and CRM platforms

•      WordPress experience (coordinating updates, landing pages, basic content management)

•      Webinar marketing experience (promotion, logistics, follow-up sequences)

•      Experience with CRM systems, automations, and marketing workflows

•      Experience coordinating campaigns across multiple channels simultaneously

•      LinkedIn content management experience (writing posts, responding to messages)



Who Thrives in This Role

•      You love building systems and creating order out of complexity — marketing ops is your happy place

•      You are a strong writer who can craft clear, persuasive, professional copy quickly

•      You take direction well and operationalize strategy effectively without needing to be told twice

•      You are proactive — you spot problems before they escalate and take initiative without waiting to be asked

•      You manage multiple moving parts simultaneously without becoming chaotic

•      You communicate clearly and concisely — you summarize, you don’t ramble

•      You are detail-oriented and process-minded, but you move with pace — speed and quality are not trade-offs for you

•      You are calm, low-ego, and collaborative — you run your lane and make everyone around you better

•      You are comfortable making decisions with imperfect information and course-correcting as you learn



This Role Is Probably Not a Fit If

•      You are looking for a purely strategic or executive-level marketing leadership role

•      You dislike operational execution work and prefer only high-level planning

•      You prefer highly corporate environments with many layers of management

•      You primarily identify as a content creator or social media specialist rather than a marketing generalist

•      You are highly passive or dependent on constant direction



Work-From-Home Requirements

•      Laptop or PC with Intel i5 (or equivalent) or better

•      Internet speed of at least 25 Mbps (upload & download)

•      Noise-cancelling headset

•      Power backup (UPS, generator, or nearby co-working space)

•      Quiet, dedicated home workspace with a desk



Why Join Scaledforce

Benefits & Perks:

•      13th Month Pay

•      SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG fund

•      HMO Health Insurance

•      Paid Time Off + Sick Leave: 10 PTO days (accrued) + 5 sick days after probation

•      Quarterly performance bonuses

•      Annual salary increases based on performance

•      Netflix subscription reimbursement



Career Growth:

•      Direct exposure to a founder-led brand with a premium, modern positioning

•      Long-term, stable client placement with a growing professional services firm

•      Structured onboarding, coaching, and performance feedback

•      Opportunity to build and own marketing operations end-to-end



How to Apply (Important)

Please
 the following to 

•      Updated resume

•      Short video (1–2 minutes) introducing yourself and your marketing experience — include one specific example of a campaign, funnel, or marketing initiative you helped execute end-to-end

•      Subject line: SF Marketing Manager – [Your Name]

*Only candidates who follow the instructions above will be considered



Interview Process

Our hiring process identifies strong operators with real-world execution ability, communication skills, professionalism, and follow-through.



Shortlisted candidates will complete:

•      Initial Scaledforce screening (30 min)

•      Skills and communication assessment (30 min)

•      Paid test project — a practical marketing assignment designed to reflect real work inside the business

•      Final client interview (30 min)

title: Billing Coordintor
description:
# Billing & Collections Coordinator (Part-Time)



## Compensation



**Pay:** $150 per week



## Schedule



**Regular Hours**



* Monday – Thursday: **9:00 AM – 2:00 PM**

* Friday: **11:00 AM – 4:00 PM**

* **One Saturday per month** is required.



**Additional Required Work**



* Employees must be available to work on the **1st and 16th of each month** to complete invoice processing and billing finalization. Additional hours may be required on these dates to ensure all invoices are processed accurately and on time.



## Position Summary



We are seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused **Billing & Collections Coordinator** to join our team. This position is responsible for payroll and billing finalizations, accounts receivable collections, insurance claims processing, client account problem-solving, and maintaining accurate financial records. The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, and able to work independently while providing excellent customer service.



## Key Responsibilities



* Review and finalize payroll for accuracy, ensuring correct pay rates and proper documentation.

* Review and finalize client billing to ensure invoices are accurate and complete.

* Generate and distribute invoices in a timely manner.

* Manage accounts receivable and conduct collection efforts on outstanding balances.

* Maintain and reconcile an accurate **Accounts Receivable (A/R) Summary Report**, tracking outstanding balances, collections, adjustments, and payment activity.

* Utilize **QuickBooks** to manage customer accounts, invoicing, payments, and financial records.

* Process and follow up on insurance claims, including submissions, denials, and payment status.

* Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies, insurance payment issues, and client account concerns.

* Assist clients with billing questions, payment arrangements, and account resolution.

* Maintain accurate payroll, billing, collections, and financial documentation.

* Collaborate with internal departments to resolve payroll and billing issues.

* Ensure compliance with company policies and payer requirements.

* Identify opportunities to improve billing accuracy and collection efficiency.



## Required Qualifications



* Minimum of **2 years of experience** in medical billing, home health billing, payroll, accounts receivable, or collections.

* **Required experience using QuickBooks.**

* **Experience maintaining and reconciling an Accounts Receivable (A/R) Summary Report.**

* Knowledge of insurance claims processing and reimbursement practices.

* Strong understanding of payroll verification and billing accuracy.

* Excellent customer service and problem-solving skills.

* Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office.

* Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Home Health billing experience.

* Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance billing experience.

* Experience with home health software.

* Strong analytical and communication skills.



**If you are highly organized, experienced in billing and collections, proficient with QuickBooks, and enjoy solving client account issues, we encourage you to apply.**



Please send a recording of yourself expressing your experience.

title: AI-Powered Google Ads Specialist – Nonprofit Grant Accounts (Part-Time / 2 Accounts)
description:
We are seeking a forward-thinking, AI-augmented Part-Time Google Ads Specialist to manage and optimize two Google Ad Grant accounts for our nonprofit organization. Each account receives $10,000/month in advertising credit, and we want someone who leverages modern AI tools — particularly Claude Code — to work smarter, move faster, and deliver measurable results.



This is not a role for someone who follows Google's automated recommendations blindly. We want a strategic, data-driven operator who uses AI to automate the grunt work and focuses their time on what actually drives conversions.



Responsibilities



- AI-Assisted Campaign Management: Use Claude Code (or equivalent AI tools) connected to our Google Ads accounts to streamline keyword research, ad copy creation, bid management, and campaign restructuring across both Grant accounts.

- Bulk Ad Generation: Leverage AI to generate and test ad variations at scale — building SKAGs (Single Keyword Ad Groups) and ensuring every ad asset is tightly matched to user intent.

- Grant Compliance: Monitor and maintain both accounts to meet all Google Ad Grants requirements (minimum 5% CTR, active conversion tracking, prohibited keyword avoidance). Use automated alerts and scripts where possible.

- Negative Keyword Mining: Run ongoing AI-assisted negative keyword workflows to continuously prune wasted spend and improve relevance scores.

- Search vs. Performance Max Strategy: Apply structured judgment (not just Google's suggestions) on when to use Search campaigns vs. Performance Max — prioritizing control and profitability.

- Tracking & Analytics: Maintain accurate conversion tracking via GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Build or maintain a custom reporting view that tracks true ROAS, not just Google's default metrics.

- Automation Workflows: Set up and maintain lightweight automations (n8n, 
, or Zapier) to handle routine tasks — performance alerts, weekly reporting, anomaly detection.

- Landing Page Alignment: Ensure ad messaging is tightly matched to landing page content to maximize Quality Scores and conversion rates.

- Reporting: Deliver concise monthly reports covering grant utilization, top search terms, CTR trends, conversion milestones, and AI workflow improvements made.



Required Experience



- Google Ads Expertise: Proven track record in Search Ads with a profitability-first mindset.

- AI Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience using Claude Code, ChatGPT, or similar AI tools to assist with Google Ads tasks — campaign builds, audits, copy generation, or data analysis.

- Google Ad Grants Knowledge: Direct experience managing nonprofit Grant accounts and navigating their specific restrictions.

- Analytical Skills: Strong proficiency in GA4, conversion event setup, and building meaningful performance dashboards.

- Automation Experience: Familiarity with at least one workflow automation tool (n8n, 
, Zapier, or similar).

- Communication: Strong written English for ad copy, reporting, and async updates.



Bonus Skills (Nice to Have)

- Experience with SKAGs and pinned headline strategies in Responsive Search Ads

- Familiarity with GitHub or Vercel for tracking/script deployment

- Experience with GoHighLevel, Airtable, or ClickUp for campaign project management



Work Schedule & Budget

- Role Type: Part-Time (approx. 5–10 hours per week, depending on account needs)

- Location: Remote (OnlineJobsPH)

- Schedule: Flexible, with a required weekly async check-in and responsiveness during your declared working hours

- Rate: $5–$8/hour depending on experience and AI tool proficiency



Screening Questions (must be included in the job post):

1. Have you used Claude Code, ChatGPT, or any AI tool to assist with Google Ads tasks? If yes, describe specifically how you used it and what the outcome was.

2. How many Google Ad Grant accounts have you managed, and for how long? What CTR did you maintain?

3. Are you Google Ads certified? If yes, please share a link to your credential.

4. Describe a Google Ad Grants compliance issue you encountered and how you resolved it.

5. What automation tools (n8n, 
, Zapier, scripts, etc.) have you used in an ads or marketing workflow?

6. What is your availability (days/hours per week) and your desired hourly rate?

description:
We are now hiring Customer Support Experts to assist our customers over the phone.

This is a full-time position only with long-term potential



Customers will call us and ask for assistance with various tasks, such as:



Checking their email accounts

Purchasing items they need

Signing up for services

Logging into or managing their accounts

Checking or signing up for credit score reports

Conducting general online searches



The tasks we handle are all things that can be done online.



PAY & EARNING STRUCTURE



Base rate starts at $4.50 per hour.

Agents usually work 10 hours per day including the paid breaks, and we allow more hours if someone wants to earn more.

During busy times, we also pay time-and-a-half overtime when we need additional coverage.

Good performers can earn a monthly bonus between $60 and $150.

There is a $50 monthly attendance bonus for consistent on-time performance.

Every 6 months, we evaluate performance and agents can receive up to an extra $0.50 per hour added to their rate if they are doing well.



With base hours plus bonuses and performance increases, a strong performer can earn up to around $1,100 per month.



This is the roadmap of our hiring process:



- You will take a quiz that typically takes about an hour to complete.

- If you pass the quiz, you will be invited to take two live mock calls or skill tests. The first one usually takes around 20 minutes, and the second one is longer, typically about an hour.

- Once you pass, you will then proceed with orientation and training.



Please note that our quizzes and skill tests can be challenging for beginners and require sharpness, speed and excellent attention to details. If you believe you possess these skills, feel free to apply.



You need to have fluent English as well as having very good internet connection and a quiet place to work.

Please apply only if you are fully available for a full-time position.

Please do not apply if you are not based in the Philippines.



When You Apply*



Please answer the following questions:



1. How many hours are you available daily, and on which days of the week?

2. How soon are you ready to start?



Lastly, please include a link to a Vocaroo audio recording (minimum 45 seconds) where you briefly introduce yourself. Tell us a bit about your background, relevant experience, and one hobby you genuinely enjoy. This is a voice account and you will be supporting customers, so it's essential that you send a high-quality voice recording.



Thanks,

Alfred

Full-time remote · Freelance / Independent Contractor · Long-term

US$700–US$850+ per month



ABOUT VILLA ALEJANDRO

Villa Alejandro operates a growing collection of boutique hotels in Boquete, Panama. We currently manage six hotels with more than 60 accommodation units and are expanding to 10 properties and beyond.



This is not a traditional hotel receptionist or front-desk position, and it is not generic virtual-assistant work.



This is a remote digital-operations role focused on text-based guest communication, reservations, payment and check-in controls, booking platforms, CRM systems and coordination across multiple hotel accounts.



You must be able to read quickly, type accurately, monitor several communication channels continuously and switch between systems without losing open tasks.



Traditional hotel experience is helpful, but proven experience in remote CRM, ticketing, BPO chat support, dispatch, travel reservations, e-commerce operations or short-term-rental management is more relevant.



REQUIREMENTS – READ BEFORE APPLYING



- Fluent written and spoken English, approximately C1 level. No certificate is required.

- Minimum typing speed of 50 WPM. A speed of 60 WPM or higher is preferred.

- Complete the 1-minute test at 
 before applying.

- Computer with at least 8 GB RAM and SSD storage. 16 GB RAM is preferred.

- Computer capable of running at least 20 active browser tabs and video calls smoothly.

- Computer used only by you. Shared devices are not accepted for confidentiality reasons.

- Stable primary internet connection of at least 20 Mbps.

- Separate backup internet through a mobile SIM card or hotspot.

- Power backup capable of keeping your laptop and internet equipment working during an outage.

- Private, professional and interruption-free workspace.

- Camera and screen sharing available for interviews, training and scheduled meetings.

- Availability for both rotating shifts.

- Availability to work weekends and holidays according to the team roster.

- Willingness to use Time Doctor while clocked in. Nothing is monitored outside your scheduled working time.

- No other paid work during Villa Alejandro shifts.

- Any interruption, outage or absence during a shift must be reported immediately.



Typing speed, computer performance, internet connections, backup systems, workspace and other claims will be verified live during the interview.



THE ROLE



You will be the first point of contact for international hotel guests.

Your responsibilities include:



- Responding to guest inquiries and supporting reservations

- Checking reservation, payment and online check-in status

- Verifying all requirements before sending room-access information

- Communicating through WhatsApp,
, 
, Airbnb, Expedia and other channels

- Working in Cloudbeds, Cloudbeds Guest Experience and multiple hotel accounts

- Coordinating with housekeeping and local hotel operations

- Recording completed actions, pending items and required follow-ups

- Preparing clear handovers for the next shift

- Using approved SOPs, templates, AI translation and voice-to-text tools

- Reporting technical or communication-system problems immediately



You may have several guest conversations, hotel accounts and internal messages open at the same time.



You must notice new messages without reminders, manage multiple active conversations, complete the full workflow and clearly document what is completed, pending or blocked.



If you prefer calm, slow or single-task work, this position is not suitable for you.



AUTHORITY AND JUDGMENT



- Refunds, discounts, compensation, free late checkouts, payment exceptions, room-access exceptions and other policy exceptions require supervisor approval.

- You must not make unauthorized financial or operational promises to guests.



Strong candidates know how to act independently within established procedures and when to stop and escalate a decision.



RELEVANT EXPERIENCE

- BPO chat support

- CRM or ticketing operations

- Remote customer operations

- Dispatch or scheduling

- Airline or travel reservations

- E-commerce customer support

- Remote short-term-rental operations

- High-volume written customer service

- Appointment or service coordination

- Cloudbeds or another hotel PMS

- 
, Airbnb, Expedia or other OTA extranet experience

- Spanish



Spanish is not required. We use approved AI translation tools and templates.



Between otherwise equally qualified candidates, Spanish is a strong advantage.



SCHEDULE



The standard schedule is five shifts and 40 paid working hours per week.

Five working days per week are mandatory. Working days may include weekends and holidays.

You must be available for both rotating shifts.



AM SHIFT



8:00 AM–4:30 PM Panama time

9:00 PM–5:30 AM Philippine time



PM SHIFT



3:00 PM–11:30 PM Panama time

4:00 AM–12:30 PM Philippine time



Each shift includes eight paid working hours and a 30-minute unpaid meal break.

An optional sixth weekly shift may be worked by mutual agreement and according to operational requirements.

An approved sixth shift is paid proportionally. Additional approved working hours are paid separately.



COMPENSATION AND DEVELOPMENT



- Starting compensation: US$700 per month

- The starting compensation covers five shifts and 40 working hours per week

- Payment is made weekly through Western Union

- Villa Alejandro covers the Western Union transfer fee

- Performance and compensation are reviewed after three months

- A higher compensation will be discussed based on verified performance

title: Land Acquisition Architect
description:
**Role Summary**

The Land Acquisition Manager is a production-based role focused on driving revenue by converting leads into signed purchase agreements. Unlike administrative roles, this position is centered on high-volume phone communication, building rapport with sellers, and closing deals. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, is comfortable negotiating, and focuses on solving seller problems to secure properties at profitable margins.



**Key Responsibilities**



*   **Pipeline Management & Closing:**

    *   Manage the "Second Call" in a two-call close system. While a Lead Manager gathers initial property data, the Acquisition Manager spends 80% of the call focusing on the seller (the person) and only 20% on the property to uncover motivation and pain points.

    *   Present offers to landowners with the autonomy to negotiate within pre-set price ranges (e.g., up to 50% of market value) without needing constant executive approval.

    *   Review purchase agreements live with sellers over the phone to increase signature rates and handle last-minute hesitations.

*   **Aggressive Follow-Up:**

    *   Execute a rigorous follow-up cadence, such as "triple dialing" (calling three times in quick succession) to increase connection rates with leads.

    *   Prioritize leads based on "recency and urgency," ensuring new leads are contacted immediately and hot leads are not neglected.

    *   Manage a "bucket" system for follow-up, calling leads daily for the first 48 hours, then transitioning to a weekly or bi-weekly cadence.

*   **Objection Handling & Negotiation:**

    *   Navigate common "deal killers" and objections, specifically regarding: Certainty/Trust, Timing, Partners/Spouses, and Price 

    *   Utilize "blame shifting" (referencing what other investors are paying) and NLP (Neuro-Linguistic Programming) techniques to negotiate lower purchase prices without alienating the seller 

    *   Uncover the seller's "lowest acceptable offer" to maximize profit margins 



**Required Skills & Traits**



*   **Thick Skin & Resilience:** Must be extremely comfortable with rejection. The candidate must be accustomed to hearing "no" frequently and not taking it personally 

*   **High Accountability:** Must take ownership of mistakes and results rather than shifting blame to the process or the leads 

*   **Coachability:** Must be willing to listen to call recordings, accept feedback during weekly reviews, and roleplay scenarios to improve sales skills.

*   **Emotional Intelligence:** Ability to build trust and connect with sellers quickly. They must pass the "Road Trip Test" (someone you could tolerate being in a car with for 8 hours).

*   **Sales Proficiency:** Experience in sales is preferred, specifically the ability to use tonality and pacing to influence conversations 

**Please send a voice message mentioning why you would be good at the job and say pink pony at the end.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Success in this role is measured by specific metrics, not just activity 

*   **Offers Made:** Tracking the volume of verbal or written offers presented to sellers

*   **Verbal Acceptance Rate:** The percentage of offers that receive a verbal "yes" (target is often 10-12% for wholesale deals) 

*   **Contracts Signed:** The conversion rate from verbal acceptance to a signed purchase agreement .



**Compensation Structure**

$8 base pay/starting pay, $9 after three months….

*   **Commission Focus:** This role is typically structured as "eat what you kill," often involving a 5% to 10%commission on the deal's profit.

*   **Bonus Structure:** Compensation includes a base pay plus significant bonuses per closed deal to incentivize performance.

Treasury & Reconciliation Analyst — Remote (Australian Lender)



*Company:* Archer Wealth (Australian non-bank lender)

*Type:* Full-time or part-time · 100% remote

*Schedule:* Some overlap with Sydney business hours (AEST) — you're only ~2–3 hours behind us



---



About the role



Archer Wealth is an Australian non-bank lender. We're looking for a detail-obsessed *Treasury & Reconciliation Analyst* to make sure our numbers always match — across our loan management system, bank accounts, and portfolio reports. If you're the kind of person who can't rest until the last cent lines up, you'll fit right in.



What you'll do



- Reconcile loan and portfolio data (daily/weekly) across multiple systems — our loan management system, bank statements, and accounting records — and confirm everything matches.

- Investigate and document discrepancies ("breaks"): identify the cause and flag them clearly.

- Support month-end: loan balance checks, transaction matching (drawdowns, repayments, interest, fees), and arrears reviews.

- Help prepare and sanity-check portfolio and reporting data before it goes out.

- Maintain clean, well-organised reconciliation logs and working papers.

- Be a reliable second set of eyes — flag anything unusual promptly.

- Background in accounting, bookkeeping, or finance (BS Accountancy or similar is a plus).

- Solid reconciliation experience — bank recs, ledger matching, or similar.

- Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills.

- *Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy — this is the #1 requirement.*

- Clear written English and good communication.

- Reliable, organised, and able to work independently.

- Comfortable handling confidential financial information with discretion.



Nice to have



- Experience in lending, loan servicing, banking, mortgages, or a finance BPO.

- Familiarity with Xero.

- Exposure to loan management systems or treasury / portfolio reporting.



Details



- *Rate:* Php 60,000 – Php 75,000 — competitive for the right person.

- Long-term role with room to grow as we build out our finance function.

title: Wholesale Sales Assistant
description:

Wholesale Sales Assistant



Job Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time, with a 1-hour break

Salary: $1,200 per month



Job Overview: 

We are seeking a detail-oriented Wholesale Sales Assistant to support our growing U.S. wholesale business. This role will serve as the primary coordinator for wholesale order documentation and ERP transactions while providing management with timely, accurate reports to support informed decision-making. The ideal candidate will be responsible for sales order documentation, pricing verification, ERP order entry, purchase order creation, and sales reporting, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure efficient order processing and exceptional customer support.



Key Responsibilities:



Order Processing & Documentation

* Create and maintain all required wholesale sales documentation.

* Verify customer purchase orders for completeness and accuracy.

* Create Sales Orders (SO) in the ERP system.

* Create Purchase Orders (PO) in the ERP system as required.

* Ensure all documentation complies with internal procedures before orders are released to Operations.



Pricing & Data Verification

* Verify customer pricing against approved pricing lists and contracts.

* Confirm that promotions, discounts, freight terms, and payment terms are accurately reflected.

* Identify pricing discrepancies and coordinate with Sales Management to resolve issues before order processing.



Sales Reporting & Analytics

* Prepare recurring sales reports for management.

* Track wholesale sales performance by customer, channel, product category, and salesperson.

* Maintain dashboards to monitor order status, shipments, backorders, inventory allocation, and sales trends.

* Support management with ad hoc reporting and data analysis.



ERP & Process Support

* Maintain accurate customer and order information within the ERP system.

* Ensure data integrity across Sales Orders, Purchase Orders, inventory allocation, and shipping records.

* Assist in developing standardized operating procedures and documentation.

* Support continuous improvement initiatives to streamline wholesale operations.



Customer Communication & Support

* Respond to wholesale customer inquiries and requests received through designated wholesale
 accounts.

* Provide timely updates regarding order status, product availability, shipping timelines, and documentation requests.

* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve customer inquiries and ensure accurate information is communicated.

* Escalate complex issues to Sales Management or the appropriate departments as needed.



Cross-Functional Coordination

* Work closely with Sales, Operations, Warehouse, Purchasing, Customer Service, and Finance to ensure orders are processed accurately and shipped on time.

* Communicate order status updates and resolve documentation-related issues promptly.



Required Skills & Qualifications:

* 1–3 years of experience in sales support, order management, customer service, operations, or a related role.

* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and basic reporting.

* Exceptional attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

* Experience using ERP systems such as NetSuite, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Acumatica, or similar platforms is preferred.



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

Before/after or comparison-style concepts where appropriate.

Promotional and offer-based creatives.

Educational/product benefit ads.

Fishing, camping and boating-specific creative.

Creating variations of proven winners to identify what elements are driving performance.

Repurposing UGC and lifestyle photography into static ads.

Working with our team to continually improve creative based on Meta performance data.

Maintaining a high level of visual quality despite the volume of output.

The biggest thing we're looking for



We want someone who understands performance creative.



A beautiful graphic that doesn't generate clicks or purchases isn't necessarily a successful ad.



You should understand concepts such as:



Hook ? Problem ? Product ? Benefit ? Proof ? CTA



and know that sometimes an intentionally simple/raw ad can outperform something that looks like a magazine advertisement.



You should be able to look at a product, understand the customer problem and come back with multiple completely different ways of selling it visually.



For example, one product could generate concepts around:



Cost savings

"Never buy ice again"

Ice melting before you've caught your first fish

Keeping a catch cold all day

Servo ice vs reusable ice

Customer reviews

Product demonstrations

Long-term cost comparisons

Australian heat

Remote fishing/camping

Esky organisation

Product durability

Social proof

Promotional offers



We want someone who naturally thinks in terms of angles and concepts, not just layouts.



Volume & expectations



The target is approximately 40 completed static creatives every week.



Quality is extremely important.



We're specifically not looking for:



1 template × 10 headlines × 4 background colours = 40 ads.



Some controlled variations are useful for testing, but the weekly output should contain a healthy number of genuinely new concepts.



We would rather work with someone who can build a repeatable creative system that consistently produces strong ideas at scale.



Creative direction



Freeflo is an Australian brand with a strong and growing customer base across fishing, camping, boating and outdoor recreation.



Our advertising should feel:



Australian. Outdoor. Bold. Clean. Premium. Direct.



We don't want everything to look overly corporate or excessively polished.



Some ads should look premium and heavily designed.



Others should look native to
/Instagram.



Others may deliberately resemble a customer review, screenshot, comparison, meme, diagram or simple product demonstration.



The goal is ultimately performance, not design awards.



Who we're looking for



Ideally, you:



Have significant experience designing Meta/Facebook/Instagram ads for e-commerce brands.

Have worked with high-volume performance creative before.

Understand direct-response advertising.

Can produce high-quality work quickly.

Are comfortable generating ideas rather than waiting for every concept to be dictated to you.

Understand visual hierarchy and mobile-first design.

Can work from existing brand guidelines without making every advertisement look identical.

Are highly proficient in Photoshop and/or equivalent professional design software.

Can perform high-quality photo manipulation and compositing.

Understand how to make physical products look premium.

Can take feedback and iterate quickly.

Have excellent attention to detail.

Understand the difference between brand creative and performance creative.



Experience with outdoor, fishing, camping, 4WD, boating or Australian e-commerce brands would be a major advantage.



What we'll provide



We'll give you access to a large library of:



Professional product photography

Lifestyle photography

UGC

Product videos

Customer reviews

Brand assets

Logos

Previous advertising

Existing winning creatives

Product information

Offers/promotions

Customer pain points

Marketing angles and ideas



We will also provide feedback on which ads are actually performing, allowing you to learn what works for Freeflo and develop better creative over time.



Ongoing relationship



We're not looking for someone to complete 40 ads and disappear.



We're looking for a designer who can become an ongoing part of our creative operation and develop a strong understanding of the Freeflo brand, products and customers.



For the right person, this could become a significant ongoing role.



As you learn what performs, we expect you to become increasingly proactive in suggesting new concepts and identifying opportunities based on previous winners.



When applying



Please include:



Your portfolio of Meta/e-commerce advertising creative.

Examples of static ads you've designed specifically for paid social.

Any examples where you know the ads generated strong results.

Brands you've previously produced performance creative for.

Your experience producing creative at high volume.

Software you primarily use.

Your availability each week.

Your expected weekly/monthly rate for approximately 40 creatives per week.



Please do not send us a general graphic-design portfolio containing primarily logos, websites and branding projects.



We're specifically interested in seeing paid social / e-commerce advertising creative.



Paid trial



Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete a paid creative trial using one of our products.



We'll provide the same product assets and a basic brief to several shortlisted designers and ask each person to develop a small number of different advertising concepts.



This will allow us to assess not only design quality, but also your ability to think creatively, understand the product and develop advertising concepts that could actually sell it.

title: Part-Time Cold Caller (Outbound B2B Sales) — English + Spanish Speakers Wanted
description:
We are a U.S.-based service company looking for a confident, part-time

outbound cold caller who can pick up a phone, start a conversation with a

business owner, and book the appointment.



This is not a script-reading, tick-the-box role. You are the first voice a

prospect hears. We want someone who is comfortable being told "no" fifteen

times and still sounds warm on call sixteen.



You will call U.S. businesses during U.S. business hours, introduce our

service, qualify whether they need it, and hand the interested ones to our

team. Calls are made from a dialer we provide — you do not need your own

phone system and you are not paying for calls.



We are growing our sales side right now, so there is real room here for

someone who produces. Perform, and this becomes more hours and better pay.



What You Will Do



- Make outbound calls to U.S. business contacts from a list we provide

- Introduce our service clearly in under 30 seconds

- Qualify the prospect: do they need it, who d
, when

- Book the call or hand off the interested lead to our team

- Log every call and its outcome the same day, no exceptions

- Send a short end-of-shift summary: calls made, contacts reached,

  leads booked



What We Need From You

REQUIRED

- Clear, confident spoken English with a neutral, easy-to-understand accent

- Previous outbound calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, or sales

  experience (BPO outbound counts)

- Reliable computer, headset, and a stable internet connection

  (please state your speed)

- A quiet place to work — no background noise on calls

- Available during U.S. business hours, [X] hours per week

- Willing to be recorded and coached — we listen to calls and give feedback



STRONG PLUS

- Conversational Spanish. A large part of the U.S. market we call is

  Spanish-speaking, and callers who can switch languages mid-call are worth

  more to us and will be paid more.

- Filipino/Tagalog for internal team communication

- Experience with a CRM or a power dialer

- B2B experience specifically (calling businesses, not consumers)



WE DO NOT NEED

- Perfect grammar in writing

- A degree

- Ten years of experience



We would rather pay well for results than cheaply for hours. If you

consistently book, we will increase both.



How To Apply

Applications that skip a step are not read. This is the first test of

whether you follow instructions on a call.



1. Put the word BLUEBIRD as the first word of your application. If it is

   not there, we will not open it.



2. Record a voice clip, 60 seconds, and send us the link

   (Google Drive, Vocaroo, or a voice message):

     - First 30 seconds IN ENGLISH: pretend you are calling a business

       owner who did not ask to hear from you. Introduce yourself and try

       to keep him on the phone.

     - Last 30 seconds IN SPANISH, if you speak it: the same thing, in

       Spanish. Skip this half if you do not speak Spanish — you can still

       be hired.



3. Answer these in two sentences each:

     - What is the hardest objection you have ever gotten on a call, and

       what did you say back?

     - How many dials did you make on your busiest day, and how many

       people did you actually reach?



4. Tell us your available hours in U.S. Eastern Time and your internet

   speed.



We reply to every applicant who follows all four steps.

title: MATHS / SCIENCE TEACHERS (QUALIFIED TEACHERS ONLY NEED APPLY)
description:
About Teach 1-2-1



Teach 1-2-1 is New Zealand's leading online tutoring service. We give New Zealand children one-to-one lessons with a real teacher, at home, in maths, English and the sciences.



We are a small team, and we work the way good teachers want to work. We do not fill your day with meetings or paperwork. We give you the resources, the training and the support you need, and then we let you teach.



Your work matters. Many of our students have lost confidence in a large classroom. You will be the person who gives it back to them. You will teach the same children for months and years, and you will watch them improve.



The pay is simple and it is certain. Qualified teachers earn up to NZ$10 per hour. We pay you for 20 hours every week from your very first week, even while we are still building your timetable. You do not wait months to earn a full income.



Our teaching hours



Our students live in New Zealand, so we work to New Zealand time. All times below are New Zealand time.



Monday to Friday: 3:30pm to 9:00pm NZ time. (About 10:30am to 5:00pm in the Philippines. New Zealand changes its clocks twice a year, so this can move by one hour.)

Saturday: 10:00am to 4:00pm NZ time. (About 5:00am to 12:00pm in the Philippines.)



We build your timetable inside these hours and give it to you. Your lessons then stay at the same times each week, so your students always know when to expect you, and so your 20 hours of guaranteed pay are protected.



Please only apply if you can work inside these hours, including Saturday mornings. This role is not casual work to fit around another job.



What you will do



Teach one-to-one online lessons on Google Meet to New Zealand students aged 5 to 18.

Prepare each lesson using our resource library, which follows the New Zealand curriculum.

Write a short report for the parent after every lesson. Google Meet creates an AI summary of your lesson, so this takes only a few minutes.

Track how each student is progressing, and change your teaching when a student needs something different.

Build a warm and trusting relationship with each student and their family.

Teach the timetable we give you, at the same times each week.

Join our team training sessions and tell us what you need to teach well.



What you need



Essential:

You are a qualified teacher with a valid professional teaching licence.

Your main subject is maths, English, or one of the sciences, and you can teach it confidently up to Senior High School level (age 18).

You can also teach a second subject from maths, English or the sciences to elementary students (up to age 12).

Your spoken and written English is excellent. Our lessons are one-to-one, so your students hear you and speak with you for the whole hour.

You can commit to 20 or more hours each week inside our teaching hours above, including Saturday mornings.

You have a computer, a headset with a microphone, a reliable internet connection, and a quiet place to teach.



Helpful, but not essential:



Experience teaching online, or teaching one student at a time.

Experience with the New Zealand curriculum, or another international curriculum.

Confidence using Google Meet and Google Docs.



We welcome applications from teachers at every stage of their career. We are interested in how well you teach, not in how many years you have been doing it.



Please note: our need is mainly with older students. If all of your teaching experience is with elementary children, this particular role is not the right one for you. Our needs change as we grow, so please watch for our future adverts.



What we offer you



20 hours of pay every week, guaranteed from your first week.

Long-term students, so you keep the relationships you build.

A full library of teaching resources, so you are never planning from nothing.

Light paperwork, helped by AI lesson summaries.

Full onboarding and training, and a team that answers when you ask for help.

Work from home, with no travel and no classroom duty.

International teaching experience with the New Zealand curriculum, which is valuable on any teacher's CV.

More hours available as you grow, for teachers who want them.



How to apply



Please send us these four things:



A link to your CV. Please share it as a PDF from Google Drive, Dropbox, or OneDrive, and set the sharing option to "anyone with the link can view".

A link to a 2-minute video of yourself. Use Google Drive, unlisted YouTube, or Loom. This video matters to us more than anything on paper. Our families choose teachers they like and trust, and the video shows us who you are. Please speak to us as you would speak to a new student. It does not need to be perfect.

Your two subjects, and the ages you teach in each one.

Start your message with the word CLASSROOM, so we know you have read this advert fully, and confirm that you can work our teaching hours.



Please send links, not attachments. We cannot open attached files, and we do not want to miss your application.



What happens next



We read your application and watch your video. If we would like to take it further, we will reply within 5 working days.

We invite you to a short interview on Google Meet, so we can meet you properly and answer your questions.

We ask you to teach a short demonstration lesson.

We make an offer and start your onboarding.



We would like to hear from you. Apply today and help New Zealand students achieve their best.
