title: Content Writer – Website Pages
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Mid-Level



About the Company:

Fence Marketing Pros is a specialized digital marketing agency that works exclusively with fence contractors.



We help fence companies strengthen their online presence, generate qualified leads, and book more fence installation projects through website development, SEO, Google Ads, Google Business Profile optimization, reputation management, social media marketing, landing pages, retargeting, and lead tracking.



Because we focus specifically on the fencing industry, we understand the services, customers, markets, and challenges of fence companies. Our team creates customized marketing strategies designed to turn our clients’ websites into effective lead-generation and sales tools.



We are looking for a talented Content Writer to help us create informative, SEO-friendly, and conversion-focused website content for our clients.



About the Role:

As our Content Writer, your primary responsibility will be writing website pages for fence companies across the United States.



You will turn client information, SEO instructions, and industry research into clear and helpful content that answers customers’ questions and encourages them to request an estimate or contact the fence company.



The content may cover topics such as:

* Residential fencing

* Commercial fencing

* Wood fencing

* Vinyl fencing

* Aluminum fencing

* Chain-link fencing

* Privacy fencing

* Pool fencing

* Fence installation

* Fence replacement and repair

* Gates and access control

* Service-area and location-specific fencing services



You must be comfortable researching unfamiliar services and writing content that is accurate, natural, useful, and specific to each client.



What Your Work Will Look Like:



A typical website content assignment may include:

1. Reviewing the content brief, page outline, target keywords, and client information.

2. Researching the client’s services, service areas, target customers, and unique selling points.

3. Reviewing the client’s existing website to understand its brand voice and avoid duplicate information.

4. Researching the assigned fence type, service, or location.

5. Writing the website page based on the approved outline and SEO requirements.

6. Adding clear headings, calls to action, internal-linking opportunities, and frequently asked questions when required.

7. Fact-checking the content and confirming that it accurately reflects the client’s services.

8. Editing the page for grammar, clarity, readability, flow, and consistency.

9. Submitting the completed content by the assigned deadline.

10. Revising the content based on feedback from the SEO, operations, or website development team.



Depending on the project, you may work on new website builds, website redesigns, page expansions, or content updates for existing clients.



Types of Pages You Will Write:

* Home pages

* About Us pages

* Main service pages

* Individual fence service pages

* Fence material pages

* Residential and commercial fencing pages

* City and service-area pages

* Landing pages

* Frequently Asked Questions

* Contact page content

* Calls to action and other website copy



Key Responsibilities:

* Write original, engaging, and conversion-focused website content.

* Create content that is useful to readers while following SEO best practices.

* Research fencing services, materials, installation methods, and local markets.

* Understand the customer’s search intent and answer the questions they are likely to have.

* Follow content briefs, keywords, outlines, templates, and brand guidelines.

* Naturally incorporate primary and secondary keywords without keyword stuffing.

* Match the writing style and brand voice of each client.

* Write compelling headings, introductions, calls to action, and page sections.

* Ensure that location pages are unique and not simply duplicated with city names changed.

* Verify that all services, claims, locations, warranties, and company details are accurate.

* Edit and proofread content for grammar, spelling, clarity, flow, and readability.

* Make revisions promptly based on team feedback.

* Manage multiple writing assignments and consistently meet deadlines.

* Communicate immediately when information is missing, unclear, or conflicting.



Qualifications:

* At least two to three years of professional content-writing or copywriting experience.

* Strong experience writing website pages, service pages, landing pages, or local SEO content.

* Excellent written English, grammar, editing, and research skills.

* A solid understanding of SEO, keywords, search intent, headings, internal links, and content structure.

* Ability to write persuasive copy without sounding overly promotional.

* Ability to explain technical or industry-specific topics in simple language.

* Strong attention to detail and fact-checking skills.

* Ability to follow detailed instructions, templates, and content briefs.

* Ability to receive feedback professionally and apply revisions consistently.

* Strong time-management and organizational skills.

* Reliable internet connection and ability to work independently in a remote environment.



Preferred Experience:



Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:

* Writing for company websites

* Writing for home service businesses

* Local SEO and location-page writing

* Digital marketing or SEO agency work

* Construction, landscaping, roofing, HVAC, plumbing, or similar industries

* Conversion copywriting

* WordPress

* Google Docs

* ClickUp

* Search Atlas

* PageOptimizer Pro or similar SEO tools



Previous fencing-industry experience is helpful but not required. However, you must be willing to learn the industry and understand the differences between fence materials, services, and customer needs.



Content Quality Standards:



All content must be:

* Original and free from plagiarism

* Accurate and properly researched

* Specific to the client and assigned location

* Easy for the average customer to understand

* Organized with clear and logical headings

* Helpful rather than repetitive or keyword-stuffed

* Consistent with the client’s actual services and brand

* Written to encourage readers to take the next step

* Carefully proofread before submission



Use of AI Tools:



AI tools may be used to assist with brainstorming, research, or outlining. However, we are not looking for someone who simply generates content and submits it without reviewing it.



Every page must be:

* Carefully written or substantially edited by the writer

* Fact-checked for accuracy

* Customized for the individual client

* Reviewed for natural language and readability

* Free from repetitive, generic, or obviously AI-generated wording



The writer remains fully responsible for the accuracy and quality of every submitted page.



How to Apply?



Please submit the following:



1. Your updated résumé.

2. A link to your writing portfolio.

3. At least three relevant website-writing samples.

4. At least one service-page or local SEO writing sample.

5. Your expected monthly salary.

6. Your available working hours and time zone.

7. An intro video, explaining your experience writing SEO-friendly website content.

8. A list of the writing, SEO, project-management, and AI tools you have used.



Please use **“Website Content Writer Application”** as your application subject line.



Applications without relevant writing samples may not be considered.

title: Custom web application
description:
I am looking to have a custom tax practice management web application developed for my tax company.



The platform must include three separate role-based portals: an administrator portal, a tax preparer portal and a tax client portal.



The administrator portal should allow me to manage tax preparers and clients, assign clients to preparers, upload training content, monitor training completion, request missing client documents, update tax-return statuses, send secure messages, manage contracts and set each preparer’s commission percentage.



The tax preparer portal should include training modules, videos, quizzes, completion tracking, electronic contracts, commission information, assigned clients, client statuses, announcements and secure communication with management.



The tax client portal should allow clients to complete intake forms, securely upload tax documents, view missing-document requests, sign documents electronically, communicate securely and track the progress of their tax return.



The platform should also include role-based permissions, multi-factor authentication, encrypted document storage, audit logs, automated
 or text notifications, electronic signatures and a mobile-friendly design.



I am not looking for a regular informational website or a GoHighLevel setup. I am looking for a custom, secure web application that operates as a tax CRM, client portal, employee portal and learning management system.

title: Industrial Piping Estimator - Takeoff from Isometric Drawings (QA)
description:
Purplefish is a well-funded tech startup based in New York City. We build software that does automated material and labor takeoff from piping isometric drawings for industrial contractors and pipe fabricators in the US. Our QA team already includes 2 amazing teammates in the Philippines who have been with us for over two years, and we're growing it.



THIS IS NOT A TRADITIONAL ESTIMATION JOB. You'll use your estimation skills in a new way: checking the work of software instead of producing bids. It's a rare chance to sit at the intersection of tech and the trade you know. Your findings directly shape how the product improves every week, and you'll get deep exposure to how modern software is built while doing work only an experienced piping estimator can do.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- QA our software's take-offs from piping ISOs: find mistakes, missed items, and wrong counts

- Do independent manual material take-offs (MTO) from isometric drawing packages so we can compare results and measure accuracy

- Count welds and do labor takeoff from ISOs, which means genuinely interpreting the drawings, not just counting symbols

- Build clean bills of materials (BOM) and document errors so our engineers can fix them

- Help us understand where the software falls short of what a real estimator would catch



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Real experience doing material and labor takeoffs from piping isometrics (industrial work: oil and gas, chemical, power, process plants). Quantity surveying (QS) or mechanical engineering backgrounds welcome

- You can read ISOs, spool drawings, and spec sheets confidently: fittings, valves, welds, bolt-ups, pipe schedules. P&ID experience is a plus, not required

- Detail-obsessed. You enjoy finding the error nobody else caught

- Strong written and spoken English. You'll be explaining errors to a US engineering team

- Strong Excel skills. AutoCAD experience is a plus

- We prefer someone who wants to work US hours (Eastern time), but there may be an opportunity for a different schedule for the right person

-Part time and full time are both a possibility





OUR HIRING PROCESS

Shortlisted candidates will do a live takeoff assessment over video call, where you'll walk us through a take-off from a real ISO package and explain your reasoning as you go. This role requires genuine, demonstrated skill reading isometrics. Please only apply if you're confident doing this work live.



WHY JOIN

- Stable, long-term role with a funded company, not project work that dries up

- Work directly with the founders and engineering team

- Your expertise is the product's quality bar. This role has real influence



TO APPLY

Tell us briefly about your experience doing material and labor takeoffs from ISOs, including weld counting. Also your preferred hours/time zone.

title: Senior Blender & 3D Print Engineer – Prepare a 9-Foot Hulk Statue for Large-Format Printing
description:
I purchased a high-resolution Hulk STL from CGTrader and need an experienced Blender artist with large-format FDM 3D printing experience to prepare the model for printing on an Elegoo OrangeStorm Giga.



This is not a simple modeling project. I'm looking for someone who understands structural engineering, print preparation, and designing large statues that will be strong, easy to assemble, and built to last.



Printer

Elegoo OrangeStorm Giga



Build Volume:

800 × 800 × 1000 mm



What I Need

1. Inspect and Repair the Model

Inspect the STL for any errors.

Repair non-manifold geometry if necessary.

Make sure every part is watertight and fully printable.

Ensure the model is optimized for large-format FDM printing.

2. Scale the Statue



Scale the entire statue to exactly:



9 feet tall (2743.2 mm)



Maintain perfect proportions while scaling.



3. Engineer an Internal Support System



Design the strongest possible internal frame for a permanent indoor display.



I do NOT want a simple pipe running through the middle.



I want someone experienced to determine the best support system.



Examples include:



EMT conduit

Steel tubing

Threaded rod

Hybrid support system



The support system should:



Support the entire weight of the statue

Prevent leaning over time

Prevent twisting

Be hidden completely inside the statue

Be practical to assemble after printing



Please determine the best design based on experience.



4. Create Internal Support Channels



Using Blender Boolean operations:



Create all internal holes/channels needed for the support frame.



The channels should:



Fit the recommended support material

Allow easy assembly

Maintain maximum structural strength

Avoid weakening thin areas

5. Determine Which Areas Should Be Hollow or Solid



Recommend the best wall thickness.



Determine which sections should remain solid for strength.



Recommend:



Wall thickness

Infill percentage

Number of walls/perimeters

Top and bottom layers



Goal:



Strong while minimizing filament usage.



6. Divide the Statue into Printable Sections



Split the model into pieces optimized specifically for the Elegoo OrangeStorm Giga.



The cuts should:



Hide seams as much as possible

Make assembly easy

Reduce print failures

Minimize supports

Maximize strength

7. Add Alignment Features



Add alignment keys/pins where needed so every piece fits together accurately.



The assembled statue should require minimal adjustment.



8. Reinforce Weak Areas



Identify any weak areas.



Modify them if necessary.



Examples:



Ankles

Wrists

Shoulders

Neck

Thin armor/details

9. Deliverables



Please provide:



Blender (.blend)

Individual STL files

Print-ready files

Internal frame diagram

Recommended support material list

EMT/tube sizes if applicable

Assembly instructions

Recommended print settings

Experience Required



Please apply ONLY if you have experience with:



Blender

Large-format FDM printing

Preparing life-size statues

Cosplay props

Boolean modeling

Structural reinforcement

Print engineering



Please send examples of similar work.



Photos of finished projects are preferred.

title: Procurement Manager (Interior Design Background) — US Design-Build Firm
description:
A Couple & A Dream is a design-build studio in Clearwater, Florida. We design and

build kitchen and bathroom renovations, and we do both under one roof — the same

team that draws it is the team that builds it.



Our team is fully remote. Our designer and project manager work from the

Philippines, our operations manager works from Colombia, and our founders are in

Florida. You would be joining a small, senior team where your work is visible

every single day.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS



You will own everything we buy.



We are hiring one person to take full ownership of materials, from finding the

product, to negotiating the price, to making sure the right thing arrives on the

right day in the right condition.



You have an interior design background, so you can read a set of drawings, look

at a finish schedule, and understand what the designer actually meant. That is

why we are not hiring a general purchasing clerk.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Every purchase order the company issues. Nobody else will place orders.

- Turning design specifications into buyable material lists: SKU, finish, size,

  quantity with waste, vendor, price, lead time.

- Opening and managing trade accounts with US suppliers (Home Depot, Floor &

  Decor, Ferguson, tile distributors, plumbing and lighting suppliers).

- Negotiating trade discounts, volume pricing and payment terms.

- Scheduling every delivery against the construction schedule — not against when

  the material happens to be ready.

- Chasing every late order before it delays a job.

- Managing returns, damage claims and warranty claims through to the credit.

- Reconciling three documents on every order: what we ordered, what actually

  arrived, and what the vendor billed us.

- Tracking material cost against the approved estimate, in real time, and raising

  the flag while the project can still be corrected.

- Building and maintaining our material library so our designer stops losing hours

  hunting for specs, pricing and availability.

- Supporting the design team with renderings, mood boards and documentation when

  procurement work is done.



WHAT A NORMAL DAY LOOKS LIKE



You start your shift and check what did not arrive yesterday. You call three

suppliers about it. You find out a vanity is discontinued, so you source two

alternatives at the same price point and send them to the designer for approval

before anyone finds out on site. You confirm Wednesday's tile delivery against the

installer's schedule. You catch that an invoice billed us for 14 boxes when 12

arrived, and you open the claim the same day. You update the material library with

the three products you sourced this week.



It is detailed work. It repeats. It matters enormously.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU



- A degree or formal training in Interior Design. This is a requirement.

- At least 2 years in procurement, purchasing, FF&E sourcing, or as a design

  assistant with real purchasing responsibility.

- Professional written English. You will negotiate with American suppliers in

  writing every day.

- You can read floor plans, elevations and finish schedules.

- You can calculate quantities and waste factors without being walked through it.

- Comfortable in Excel or Google Sheets at the level of pivot tables and

  reconciliation.

- SketchUp and rendering ability for the design support side of the role.

- Experience working US hours from a remote setup.



You do not need JobTread experience. We will train you on it.



WHO ACTUALLY SUCCEEDS IN THIS ROLE



- You chase things without being asked. Sixty percent of this job is following up

  on orders that did not arrive.

- You can tolerate repetitive detail. You will reconcile three documents per order,

  every day, without getting sloppy in month four.

- You report bad news early. If a material will not arrive Tuesday, we need to know

  Tuesday — not Friday.

- You can say no to the design team. Part of your job is telling a designer that a

  beautiful specification cannot be bought in time or in budget, and then finding

  something that can.



PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF



- You are looking for a design-only role. This is a procurement role with a design

  component, not the other way around.

- You cannot work US Eastern hours.

- You have only placed orders someone else d
 on. We need someone who has

  owned the outcome, not just the transaction.



SCHEDULE AND PAY



- Full time, 40 hours per week

- 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time 

- We are being direct about this because it is a night shift and we do not want to

  waste your time or ours

- Salary: $[X] per month, reviewed at 6 months

- Long-term role. We are building a team, not filling a gap.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word BLUEPRINT so we know you read the whole post.



Then answer this one question in your first paragraph:



Tell me about the last time an order you placed arrived incomplete or wrong. What

did you do, in what order, and how long did it take to resolve?



Please also attach your portfolio or a few samples of your design work.



We read every application that answers the question. We do not read the ones that

do not.

title: CLIENT & CREATIVE OPERATIONS MANAGER
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring a full-time Client & Creative Operations Manager to oversee the workflow between our clients and art team.

This is not a basic administrative VA position. It is a client-facing, creatively involved role that requires excellent communication, strong organization, attention to detail, and a genuine eye for fashion and design.

You will communicate directly with clients, understand their ideas, collect references, prepare clear instructions for our artists, review completed artwork, and manage revisions through final approval.

After training, you should be able to independently manage the client-to-artwork process while maintaining our standards for communication, organization, and design quality.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Manage daily communication with clients through text,
, and other platforms.

Build professional and reliable relationships with clients.

Collect design ideas, garment references, inspiration photos, logos, colors, and project requirements.

Ask clear questions when a client’s vision or feedback is incomplete.

Translate client ideas into organized and actionable creative briefs.

Assign artwork and revisions to members of the art team.

Communicate client expectations and design direction clearly to artists.

Review all artwork and garment mockups before sending them to clients.

Identify spelling mistakes, incorrect colors, placement issues, inconsistencies, and other quality concerns.

Determine whether artwork is visually strong, fashionable, balanced, and aligned with the client’s original vision.

Collect client feedback and communicate revisions accurately to the art team.

Keep revision rounds organized and ensure important details are not lost.

Track active projects, deadlines, approvals, and required next steps.

Follow up with clients and artists to prevent delays.

Maintain organized artwork files, project records, references, and approval notes.

Learn our garments, design standards, client base, production process, and overall business.

Gradually take complete ownership of the client and artwork management process.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong customer service and client communication skills.

Exceptional organization and attention to detail.

Ability to manage multiple client projects simultaneously.

A strong eye for fashion, apparel, branding, artwork, and visual quality.

Ability to give artists clear, specific, and constructive feedback.

Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator and common artwork file types.

Ability to open, review, and understand Illustrator files. Advanced graphic design skills are helpful but not required.

Ability to learn apparel terminology, garment specifications, and production processes.

Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

Dependable, responsive, and able to complete tasks without constant reminders.

Reliable internet connection and a professional remote-work environment.

Full availability during the required US working hours.



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Experience in fashion, apparel, graphic design, merchandising, printing, manufacturing, or e-commerce.

Experience managing graphic designers or other creative professionals.

Experience communicating with US-based clients.

Experience in customer success, account management, creative operations, or project management.

Familiarity with custom apparel, garment mockups, screen printing, embroidery, or cut-and-sew production.

Experience with Adobe Illustrator, Google Drive, and project-management tools.



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

The ideal candidate is both creative and highly organized.

You should be able to review a design and recognize when it looks weak, unbalanced, incomplete, or inconsistent with the client’s references. You should also be confident communicating with both clients and artists.

Clients must feel understood and supported. Artists must receive clear, organized, and actionable instructions.

We will provide training on our products, workflow, communication style, and quality standards. However, we are looking for someone who wants to learn the entire business and eventually manage this department with confidence and minimal supervision.



SCHEDULE AND COMPENSATION

Full-time remote position.

Monday through Friday.

9:00 AM–5:00 PM Eastern Time.

Fixed monthly salary based on qualifications and experience.

Additional paid overtime opportunities may be available.

Long-term position with opportunities for increased responsibility and growth.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include the following in your application:

Your resume.

A short introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for this role.

A description of your relevant experience in client communication, customer service, fashion, apparel, graphic design, or creative project management.

Your level of experience with Adobe Illustrator.

Examples of design, apparel, branding, or creative projects you have created or managed.

Your desired monthly salary in USD.

Confirmation that you can consistently work Monday through Friday from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM Eastern Time.

A brief explanation of how you would handle a situation where a client provides unclear feedback, but the artist needs specific revision instructions.

Please begin your application with the words “Creative Operations” so we know you carefully reviewed the entire posting.

title: Trailer Management Admin (Urgent)
description:
GH Logistics (AJG Transport) is a high performance freight brokerage and asset based logistics company specializing in dry van and refrigerated freight. We move quickly, but we move with structure. Our operation is built on real-time visibility, disciplined execution, and clear communication. We take pride in keeping freight organized, assets accounted for, and operations running cleanly from pickup to delivery.



If you’re someone who enjoys structured execution, asset visibility, and maintaining operational accuracy behind the scenes, you’ll feel right at home here.



Role Overview

You support the Trailer Manager in overseeing a fleet of 1000+ trailers across multiple carriers and terminals. You play a critical role in ensuring every trailer is accounted for, properly assigned, compliant, and operational. This is not a passive data-entry role. You’re the person who keeps the fleet picture accurate, coordinates trailer repair concerns, and flags problems before they cost us time and money.



You should be familiar with common trailer repair and maintenance issues and understand how to coordinate practical solutions with drivers, terminals, vendors, and maintenance teams. If you thrive on structure, take pride in clean records, and don’t let things slip through the cracks, this role was built for you.



What You’ll Be Doing

• Monitor, update, and reconcile trailer locations across the network on a daily basis

• Coordinate with route supervisors, internal team, dispatchers, carriers, drivers, and terminals to ensure accurate trailer assignments and timely movement

• Track trailer availability, maintenance schedules, and repair status

• Identify trailer issues, assess their operational impact, and coordinate the appropriate repair solution

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date trailer documentation (registrations, inspections, tags, insurance)

• Support reporting on trailer utilization, downtime, and compliance

• Identify discrepancies, missing updates, or unreported trailer statuses and escalate promptly

• Assist in improving internal trailer tracking systems for better visibility and accuracy

• Execute processes consistently with strong attention to detail

• Collaborate cross-functionally with dispatch, compliance, and maintenance teams



What Success Looks Like

• Trailer locations and statuses are consistently accurate and fully reconciled

• Assignments, availability, and movements are properly documented and updated in real time

• Maintenance, repair, and compliance records are complete and up to date

• Trailer defects and repair needs are identified early, properly communicated, and resolved efficiently

• Discrepancies are identified early and resolved before impacting operations

• Reporting on utilization and downtime is clean, accurate, and actionable

• Communication across departments is clear, timely, and structured



Who We’re Looking For

• Experience in fleet management, trailer maintenance coordination, logistics coordination, truck or trailer repairs, dispatch, or similar live operational roles (not general admin work)

• Familiarity with common dry van and refrigerated trailer repairs, defects, and maintenance concerns

• Ability to understand trailer repair issues, determine the appropriate next steps, and coordinate solutions

• Knowledge of common trailer components and issues, such as tires, brakes, lights, doors, landing gear, air lines, electrical systems, refrigeration units, and structural damage, is strongly preferred

• Strong attention to detail with high accuracy in tracking and record-keeping

• Organized and capable of managing multiple data points across systems and teams

• Clear and professional communication skills across departments

• Familiarity with platforms such as Samsara, LoadStop, or similar tracking systems is a plus

• Proactive mindset, able to identify and address issues before they escalate

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment

• Minimum 45 WPM typing speed

• Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Logistics tools

• Reliable internet connection and fully equipped remote work setup

• Team oriented, coachable, and aligned with structured processes



Schedule & Work Setup

• Full time permanent remote role

• Direct Hire to a US Company (not agency or BPO)

• Current needed shifts: Sunday - Friday 8 PM - 6 AM CDT | Tuesday - Sunday 10 AM - 8 PM CDT

• Reliable home office setup and back up internet and power stations

• Zoom presence required (camera on throughout shift)

• Possible Hubstaff time tracking during shifts, but is not currently in use.



What You'll Get

• Independent Contractor Setup

• $75 monthly insurance stipend (eligibility begins 30 days after hire)

• Paid biweekly. No delayed payments and no excuses.

• Stable & long-term position. This is not project-based nor seasonal. We're building a team and we need people who want to build with us.

• Direct access to US executive leadership. You're not buried in a call center reporting to a middle manager. You work directly with our operations team.

• Real operations work.



Who Thrives Here

• People who've worked in a US freight brokerage or 3PL and want something more stable

• Former fleet coordinators, logistics admins, or dispatch support staff who are tired of BPO environments

• Fleet admins who take ownership. You don't clock in and zone out. You manage trailers like they are your business.

• People who can recognize trailer issues, coordinate repairs, follow up consistently, and ensure equipment returns to service as quickly as possible

• People who want to grow into leadership but need the right company to do it in.



Who This Isn't For

• General VAs looking for easy remote work. This is real logistics and not admin tasks.

• People who need constant supervision or step by step instructions for every task

• Anyone who can't commit to US shift hours consistently

• Candidates without actual freight/logistics experience. We don't have time to teach the basics.

• Candidates who are unfamiliar with trailer maintenance concerns or are uncomfortable coordinating repairs and operational solutions



This role is built for someone who takes pride in maintaining control over moving assets, ensuring trailers are accounted for, properly assigned, properly repaired, and always operational. If you value structure, accuracy, problem-solving, and keeping operations running clean behind the scenes, you’ll thrive in this role.

title: Amazon & eBay Marketplace Specialist
description:
We currently operate a successful ecommerce website, along with an Amazon and Ebay store. What you'll be responsible for:

- Optimize existing listings

- Monitor account health, handle suppressed listings, navigate category compliance

- Create and manage cases with customer support

- Track and create reports detailing sales and profitability

- Assist in inventory planning and shipment creation in FBA workflow

- Work with our in-house marketing team on creative needs

- Provide weekly written and video update detailing metrics, what changed and what's next

- Maintain documentation of your processes



Requirements:

- 3+ years actively managing Amazon Seller Central accounts

- Demonstrated experience scaling an Amazon catalog and launching new products successfully

- Direct experience managing Amazon advertising with results you can talk through

- Strong written English suitable for US consumer product listings and ad copy

- Comfortable with technical/electronics products

- Reliable communication on US business hours (ideally at least 4 hours of daily overlap with US Eastern time)

- Ability to make decisions and implement, not just recommend

- Experienced with Microsoft Excel



Our tools and platforms:

- Magento 2 ecommerce platform

- Channable manages and manipulates product feed from Magento to marketplaces

- Amazon Seller Central / eBay Seller Hub marketplace platforms

- SellerBoard reporting system

- Claude AI



Nice to have:

- Direct experience with Magento 2 and/or Channable

- Prior Ebay experience 

- Knowledge or experience with two-way radios (our primary product category)

- Familiarity with FCC certification requirements for radio listings



To apply:

- Send a short note (not exceeding 250 words) on why this role fits you. 

- Include examples of Amazon accounts that you've grown 

- Include your resume

title: L1 / T1 Technical Support Representative
description:
L1 / T1 Technical Support Representative

Philippines - Remote

Compensation: 35000 php per month +10% shift differential 

Application Link: 



THE COMPANY

DTiQ is the world's leading provider of intelligent video-based surveillance and loss prevention services. With over 20 years of service, enhancing over 8 million consumer experiences daily; DTiQ has over 45,000 customers including corporations and/or franchisees such as Burger King, KFC, and McDonald's to name a few. If you are interested in technology, loss prevention, or hospitality, advance your career at DTiQ! We're always seeking smart, talented, and driven individuals to work in our fun and fast-paced environment.



We are proud to offer a collaborative, inclusive, and growth-oriented work environment where employees are encouraged to learn, develop new skills, and build long-term careers.



For more information on DTiQ visit our website (
) or our LinkedIn page (
).



THE ROLE

As an entry level L1 Technical Support Representative (TSR), your primary responsibility will be to actively resolve end-user requests. New employees receive thorough training on DTiQ tools, products, service offerings and standard procedures. This is a full-time (40 hours per week) supporting customers during U.S. and European business hours.  

Application Link: 



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Assist customers over the phone with issues such as: account creation, password reset, video footage retrieval, and remote viewing software setup on end users laptops, personal computers and mobile devices. 

• Maintain low wait times while focusing on first call resolution. 

• Answer questions customers may have about our system and services. 

• Ensure electronic records are created and updated for all customer communications. 

• Warm transfer inbound calls to appropriate Account Specialist or Department when warranted. 

• Assist in the building of a World-Class Support Team through contribution and collaboration. 



WHY JOIN US?

• Competitive salary and benefits package 

• Opportunities for career growth and advancement 

• Supportive team environment and leadership 

• Comprehensive training provided 

• Exposure to international clients and business operations 

• Work in a dynamic and fast-paced industry 



QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience providing customer service utilizing effective technical troubleshooting skills 

• Experience with Windows Operating System, Mac OS X, remote access tools and/or support of mobile devices 

• Knowledge of CCTV and IP Camera technology 

________________________________________

How to Apply

Application Link: 



As part of our standard recruitment procedure, we kindly ask that you complete your application through Rippling, our global Human Resources Information System (HRIS).  This platform is used globally at DTiQ to ensure a consistent and secure way of managing candidate information.   



What to expect:

We understand that this process may be different from traditional application methods commonly used in the Philippines, such as submitting resumes via
 or by job postings.  Our HRIS system will require you to:

• Create a profile with a username and password for you to access throughout the recruiting process and if hired, it will be used for timekeeping and payroll. 

• Re-enter details already included in your resume (this helps us standardize globally).  We recognize this may seem repetitive but it ensures your profile is properly integrated into our global system which is necessary to schedule interviews and onboard. 

• Upload supporting documents such as your CV. 

Once your profile is complete in Rippling, we’ll begin to schedule interviews with qualified candidates.  The interview will last up to an hour and may include 1-2 people (the direct hiring manager and potentially a department lead).  

Hired candidates will be engaged through an Employment of Record (EOR) at the start of employment.  This is a widely used approach by international companies to hire talent in countries where we do not yet have a legal entity and allows us to comply with legal regulations.    This means that Rippling, our EOR provider in the Philippines will officially employ you on behalf of DTiQ Technologies while you will work day-to-day with our team.  Under this arrangement salary, government contributions and taxes are processed in compliance with Philippine regulations.  DTiQ will manage your daily work, performance and career development.  If you have further questions about this arrangement, please let me know and I’d be happy to address it with you. 



Is my data secure?

Yes, the system complies with international data privacy standards and your information will only be accessed by authorized personnel. 



What if I experience technical issues?

If you have any trouble in the Rippling system, please reply to this message so we can assist you properly.



We truly appreciate your time and effort in completing these next steps.  If you have any questions or concerns, please reach out – I’m here to help. 



At DTiQ, we value dedication, teamwork, and continuous improvement. If you are looking for a stable job with opportunities to grow and develop your skills, we encourage you to apply and be part of our global team.

title: Senior HR Assistant / Recruiter | Recruitment, Candidate Screening & HR Administration
description:
# Senior HR Assistant | Recruitment & HR Administration | 3+ Years Experience



**Full-Time | Remote | US Business Hours | Long-Term Opportunity**



We are looking for an **experienced Senior HR Assistant** to provide direct support to our HR Manager across recruitment, candidate screening, HR administration, documentation, and day-to-day HR operations.



**THIS IS NOT AN ENTRY-LEVEL POSITION.**



We are specifically looking for someone with **3+ years of professional HR or recruitment experience** who can work independently, handle confidential information, maintain accurate records, and support an active hiring process.



The right candidate should be comfortable taking ownership of assigned responsibilities rather than waiting for step-by-step instructions.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### Recruitment & Candidate Screening



* Review and evaluate resumes against specific job requirements

* Pre-screen candidates and identify qualified applicants

* Conduct initial candidate screening interviews when required

* Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring teams

* Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process

* Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment trackers

* Assist with sourcing and recruitment activities as assigned

* Identify strong candidates and escalate qualified applicants to the HR Manager



### HR Administration



* Provide daily administrative support to the HR Manager

* Prepare, organize, and review HR documents and paperwork

* Verify that forms and employee documentation are complete and accurate

* Maintain organized digital employee and HR records

* Assist with onboarding and offboarding processes

* Update HR trackers, spreadsheets, and internal databases

* Prepare reports and documentation as requested



### General Administrative Support



* Complete administrative tasks assigned by the HR Manager or management

* Maintain accurate spreadsheets and databases

* Organize files and documentation

* Follow HR procedures, SOPs, and internal processes

* Conduct research and gather information when requested

* Follow up on outstanding tasks and documentation

* Support other HR and administrative projects as needed



## STRICT REQUIREMENTS — NON-NEGOTIABLE



**Please do not apply if you do not meet ALL of the following:**



* **3+ years of professional HR, recruitment, or HR administration experience**

* Proven experience with **candidate screening and recruitment**

* Experience reviewing resumes and evaluating candidates against job requirements

* Experience supporting an HR Manager, HR team, recruiter, or hiring manager

* Strong written and spoken English

* Excellent attention to detail

* Strong organizational and time-management skills

* Ability to manage multiple priorities independently

* Comfortable handling confidential employee and candidate information

* Strong Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office skills

* Excellent Google Sheets/Excel skills

* Strong data-entry and documentation skills

* Reliable internet connection and professional work-from-home setup

* Ability to work during **US business hours**

* Demonstrated reliability and consistent attendance



**General Virtual Assistant experience alone does NOT qualify as HR experience.**



## STRONGLY PREFERRED



We will prioritize candidates with experience in:



* High-volume recruitment

* Candidate sourcing

* Resume screening

* Phone/video pre-screening

* Interview scheduling

* Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS)

* HRIS platforms

* Employee onboarding

* Employee records management

* Recruitment reporting

* Google Sheets / Excel

* Remote recruitment

* Recruiting for US-based companies

* Supporting US-based hiring managers



## WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate is:



**Experienced** — You have several years of hands-on HR/recruitment experience.



**Analytical** — You can evaluate candidates against requirements and recognize strong versus weak applicants.



**Detail-oriented** — You understand that incorrect HR documentation can create serious problems.



**Independent** — You can manage your workload without constant supervision.



**Proactive** — You identify what needs to be done and take action.



**Professional** — You communicate confidently and professionally with candidates, employees, and management.



**Confidential** — You understand how to handle sensitive employee and candidate information appropriately.



**Reliable** — You consistently meet your schedule, deadlines, and responsibilities.



## APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



**PLEASE FOLLOW THESE INSTRUCTIONS CAREFULLY.**



To be considered, your application MUST include the following:



### 1. Total HR/Recruitment Experience



State your total number of years of professional HR/recruitment experience.



**Example: 5 years**



### 2. Most Recent HR Role



Provide:



* Company/industry

* Job title

* Dates employed

* Main responsibilities



### 3. Recruitment Experience



Tell us specifically:



* Approximately how many candidates did you screen per week?

* What types of positions did you recruit for?

* Did you conduct phone/video pre-screening?

* Did you schedule interviews?

* Did you communicate directly with hiring managers?



### 4. HR & Recruitment Tools



List the platforms you have actually used, including:



* ATS

* HRIS

* CRM

* Google Workspace

* Microsoft Office

* Excel/Google Sheets

* Any recruitment platforms



**Do not simply write “proficient in Microsoft Office.” List the specific tools.**



### 5. US Recruitment Experience



Have you recruited or supported hiring for a **US-based company or US clients?**



If yes, state:



* How long

* What type of company

* What positions you recruited for



### 6. Availability



State your availability to work US business hours.



### 7. Expected Hourly Rate



Provide your expected hourly rate in **USD**.



## APPLICATION SCREENING PHRASE



Begin your application with:



**SENIOR HR ASSISTANT – [X] YEARS HR EXPERIENCE – [X] YEARS RECRUITMENT EXPERIENCE**



Example:



**SENIOR HR ASSISTANT – 5 YEARS HR EXPERIENCE – 4 YEARS RECRUITMENT EXPERIENCE**



Applications that do not follow the requested format may not be prioritized.



## WORK SETUP



* **Full-Time**

* Fully Remote

* US Business Hours

* Long-Term Opportunity

* Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications

* Opportunity for growth



**We are looking for a long-term tea
mber who can take ownership of HR and recruitment responsibilities and provide reliable support to our HR Manager.**

title: US Construction (Lighting) APM & Procurement Specialist
description:
About TamiLUX



TamiLUX is a New York–based lighting distribution company supplying architectural and

commercial lighting for construction projects across the region. We work directly with

electrical contractors, lighting designers, and manufacturers to deliver fixture packages on

time and on budget — from bid to final punch list.



About the Role



We’re looking for a detail-oriented APM (Assistant project management) & Procurement specialist to own the day-to-day coordination of active lighting projects. You’ll be the engine behind our project pipeline: tracking purchase

orders, chasing submittals and lead times, coordinating freight, and keeping internal and

external stakeholders informed. This is a behind-the-scenes operational role — client-facing

communication is handled by our US team, and you’ll support them with accurate, timely

project information.



Key Responsibilties



A. Project Coordination

- Manage multiple concurrent lighting projects from PO issuance through delivery and

closeout

- Track fixture schedules, submittals, and approvals; flag discrepancies between specs

and orders

- Maintain project status in Airtable and keep records current and accurate

- Prepare transmittals, warranty letters, change orders, and other project documentation



B. Procurement & Vendor Follow-Up

- Issue and track purchase orders with manufacturers and vendor reps

- Follow up on lead times, production status, and shipping dates; escalate delays early

- Reconcile order confirmations against POs (quantities, finishes, voltages, pricing)



C. Logistics & Freight

- Track local and domestic shipments (LTL, courier, and local deliveries)

- Coordinate with warehouses and carriers on delivery scheduling to job sites

- Confirm deliveries against POs and resolve shortages or damages with vendors



D. Communication & Reporting

- Provide daily/weekly status updates to the US team via Slack and

- Draft professional
s for internal review (vendor follow-ups, status summaries)

- Maintain organized project files in Google Drive



Requirements



- 3+ years of experience in construction AND project management (REQUIRED)

- Excellent written English — you’ll draft professional business correspondence daily

- Strong organizational skills with proven ability to track many moving parts without

dropping details

- Comfortable working full US Eastern hours (8 AM–5 PM EST / night shift PHT)

- Proficiency with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Gmail) and Slack

- Reliable home office setup: fast internet, quiet workspace, backup power/internet a plus



Nice to Have



- Experience in lighting, electrical, construction, or building materials industries

- Familiarity with Airtable or similar database/project tracking tools

- Experience reading submittals, spec sheets, BOMs, or construction documents

- QuickBooks or basic AP/AR familiarity



What We Offer



- Competitive salary (commensurate with experience)

- Long-term, stable full-time role with growth as the company scales

- Paid Philippine holidays and paid time off

- Direct exposure to US construction supply operations and modern ops tooling

- Small, collaborative team where your work is visible and valued

title: Client Onboarding / Connectivity Call Specialist
description:
We run
/Meta ad campaigns for small local businesses — roofing companies, nurseries, lighting contractors, financial advisors, home services. Before we can launch anything, we have to get connected to the client's accounts.



That's the "connectivity call": a short Zoom call where you walk a business owner through connecting their
 page and ad account to our system, and their calendar to our CRM so leads can book appointments. Calendar-only setups take five to ten minutes; anything involving
 runs twenty-five to thirty and sometimes needs a second session.



The steps aren't hard once you know them. What's hard is who you're doing them with — non-technical owners, often in their 50s and 60s, frequently taking the call from a job site, who get frustrated fast when software misbehaves. A lot of this job is calm, friendly hand-holding while someone hunts for a button.



Required

Excellent spoken English — fluent, natural, minimal accent. This is non-negotiable. You'll be on live calls with American small business owners who are already mildly frustrated with technology. If they have to work to understand you, the call falls apart. We screen for this.

Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel, specifically user setup, profile settings, and calendar integrations. You should know what "Update Availability" means without us explaining it.

Hands-on experience with Meta Business Manager /
 Ads Manager — business assets, ad accounts, page roles, asset assignment, payment methods. You don't need to be a media buyer, but you need to know Business Manager cold, including where things hide.

Real patience with non-technical people. You'll say "it's in the bottom left corner" to someone who cannot find the bottom left corner. Repeatedly. Warmly.

Ability to guide someone without seeing their screen, describing where things are clearly enough that they can find them on their own

Confident running Zoom: sending links in chat, getting someone to share their screen, sorting out audio across devices, directing someone else's screen without taking over

Comfortable on calls with several people at once, figuring out live who actually has the access you need

Reliable quiet workspace, strong internet, good headset, working webcam

Organized — this role is half live call, half clean records. Details you don't log become someone else's problem the next day.



Nice to Have

Prior agency experience onboarding clients

Familiarity with Leadsie or similar account-access tools

Experience with Airtable and Slack

Experience supporting older or non-technical users

Any customer support or account management background where you talked people through software live





Who This Is Right For

You're the person friends call when their computer isn't working, and you don't sigh about it. You're warm on the phone without sounding scripted. You can hold a friendly conversation with a sixty-year-old roofing contractor and also know exactly which submenu in Business Manager holds ad account settings. You'd rather own a process end to end than work a ticket queue.



Who This Is Not Right For

If you need a script for everything, this will frustrate you — no two of these calls go the same way. And if you're uncomfortable politely holding a boundary — "I know it's inconvenient, but we really do need you on a computer for this. Can we move to two o'clock?" — this isn't the seat.





How to Apply

Please send:



A short note on your experience with GoHighLevel and Meta Business Manager. Be specific about what you've actually done in each, not just that you've used them.

A 60–90 second voice or video recording answering this: "A business owner has joined the call on his iPhone from a job site. He's in a hurry and a little annoyed. Explain why you need him on a desktop computer, and get him to agree to reschedule." Just talk — we're listening for your English, your tone, and how you handle someone who's mildly irritated.

Your available hours in US Central Time.

title: Buyer
description:
MUST HAVE EXPERIENCE USING SAP (e.g., SAP B1, SAP S/4HANA, etc.)

Position Summary

The Buyer is responsible for supporting the procurement and inventory replenishment activities necessary to meet customer demand and maintain healthy inventory levels. This role works closely with Sales, Warehouse, Accounting, and Supplier Partners to ensure products are purchased accurately, delivered on time, and managed efficiently throughout the supply chain.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and eager to develop a career in supply chain, purchasing, and inventory management. Success in this role is measured by the ability to maintain accurate purchasing records, proactively manage supplier commitments, support inventory availability, and contribute to a positive customer experience.

________________________________________

Performance Objectives

Purchase Order Management

• Create, issue, and manage purchase orders with approved suppliers to support customer orders and inventory replenishment.

• Ensure purchase orders are accurate, complete, and aligned with company purchasing policies.

• Update purchase orders as required due to customer demand changes, supplier delays, pricing adjustments, or shipping updates.

• Confirm order acknowledgments and maintain accurate expected delivery dates.

Supplier Communication & Follow-Up

• Build and maintain professional relationships with suppliers.

• Proactively monitor supplier commitments and follow up on open orders to ensure on-time delivery.

• Identify and resolve issues related to lead times, pricing discrepancies, shipping delays, and product availability.

• Escalate potential supply risks and recommend solutions to minimize disruptions.

Inventory & Demand Management

• Monitor inventory levels and purchasing requirements to help prevent stock shortages and excess inventory.

• Review historical sales trends, forecasts, and inventory reports to support buying decisions.

• Assist in maintaining inventory levels that support customer demand while optimizing inventory investment.



Reporting & Data Accuracy

• Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier correspondence, pricing agreements, and supporting documentation.

• Reconcile daily purchasing and open order reports to ensure accurate shipment visibility.

• Analyze purchasing data and identify opportunities to improve purchasing efficiency and inventory performance.

• Support reporting initiatives by providing accurate purchasing information and updates.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Collaborate with Accounting to resolve invoice discrepancies and purchasing-related issues.

Compliance & Quality

• Maintain compliance with company policies, purchasing procedures, and documentation standards.

• Ensure purchasing activities support company quality objectives and operational requirements.

________________________________________

Key Competencies

Organization & Time Management

• Effectively prioritize multiple tasks and responsibilities while meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

• Maintain accurate records and consistently follow up on open action items.

Communication

• Communicate professionally and effectively with suppliers, customers, and internal stakeholders.

• Provide timely and accurate updates regarding order status, delays, and potential risks.

Problem Solving

• Investigate purchasing, inventory, and supplier-related issues and identify practical solutions.

• Take initiative to resolve challenges before they impact customer deliveries.

Analytical Thinking

• Utilize data, reports, and trends to support purchasing decisions.

• Evaluate inventory levels, lead times, and purchasing costs to support operational objectives.

Attention to Detail

• Demonstrate accuracy in purchase order creation, order maintenance, reporting, and supplier communications.

• Ensure information entered into company systems is complete and reliable.

Customer Focus

• Understand the importance of internal and external customer satisfaction.

• Support company objectives by helping ensure products are available when customers need them.

Adaptability & Continuous Learning

• Demonstrate a willingness to learn new systems, products, suppliers, and processes.

• Embrace change and continuously seek opportunities to improve performance and efficiency.

________________________________________

Preferred Qualifications

• Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Operations, or related field preferred.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office Suite.

• Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.

title: Graphic Design VA- Fashion Mock Ups
description:
What you'll be doing

 • Building product mockups from supplied design files across a range of blanks (hoodies, tees, crewnecks, thermals, etc.)

 • File prep and formatting: sizing, resolution, transparent backgrounds, correct color mode, export presets, consistent file naming

What we need from you

 • Strong Photoshop skills. Smart objects, layer comps, displacement maps, clipping masks, actions/batch processing. Illustrator experience is a plus.

 • Speed and availability. Mocks are often needed same-day. We need someone who can be reached and can turn work around without a multi-day lag.

 • Ability to follow a spec sheet and file naming convention exactly without needing reminders.

 • Clear written English and reliable communication.

Nice to have

 • Experience with print-on-demand or apparel e-commerce

 • Familiarity with Shopify product imagery requirements

 • Understanding of print methods (DTF, DTG, screen print) and how placement dimensions work

 • Basic knowledge of streetwear / fashion product photography conventions

How we work

You'll get design files, a blank list, and a spec. You return finished, correctly named files. Feedback is direct and specific. If you take it well and apply it consistently, this turns into steady ongoing work with more responsibility over time.

title: Co-Host / Operations Manager — Guest Experience & Team Lead
description:
The Problem We Need Solved



We run a growing short-term rental business — 18+ units across the East Coast in the United States — and for our guests, the experience begins the 
nt they hit "send" on their very first message. But we've outgrown our current setup:



- Messages need to be answered fast, warmly, and like a real human — not a copy-paste script.

- When something goes sideways, someone has to stay calm and make it right before it becomes a bad review.

- Our small VA team is talented but needs a leader to keep everyone rowing in the same direction.

- Our systems and SOPs need an owner who improves them — not just someone who follows them.



That's where you come in. We're not looking for a "virtual assistant." We're looking for a right-hand operator — a Co-Host who treats our guests like their own and our business like they've got skin in the game.



Your Mission



Be the voice our guests trust and the operator who keeps everything running behind the scenes. You are the first person a guest hears from — and the last line of defense before a small hiccup turns into a one-star surprise.



You'll…



- Own the full guest journey — inquiry, booking, check-in, mid-stay, and checkout — with fast, warm, genuinely human communication.

- Jump on a call when a message won't cut it, and resolve issues calmly in real time.

- Turn frustrated guests into 5-star reviews through sincere, thoughtful recovery.

- Coordinate cleaners, maintenance, and property teams so every turnover is guest-ready.

- Lead, train, and hold accountable a small team of VAs.

- Build and refine the SOPs that make our operation faster and tighter as we scale.

- Spot bottlenecks and bring us ideas on pricing, scheduling, and workflow.

- Handle light social media and admin as needed.



Real Talk — The Heart of This Job



Let's be upfront about what this role actually is: you'll be on the phone with upset guests often. A booking went sideways, the check-in code won't work, the unit isn't what they pictured — and you're the calm, confident voice on the other end. If phone calls with frustrated people wear you down, this isn't the role for you. If you thrive on turning tension into gratitude and finding a fix nobody else spotted, keep reading.



To do this well, you'll need:



- A neutral, no-accent English speaking voice. Guests should never have to strain to understand you. This one is non-negotiable.

- Real de-escalation instincts. You can take someone from furious to thankful in a single conversation, without ever losing your cool.

- Creative problem-solving under pressure. When there's no obvious answer, you invent one — fast, and on your feet.



This Role Is Perfect for Someone Who…



- Can turn an upset guest saying "the AC won't turn on" into a guest who still leaves five stars.

- Reads the emotion behind a message and knows exactly when to type and when to pick up the phone.

- Gets a little rush from closing out a tense situation with one calm, kind reply.

- Treats a clean inbox and a fully-confirmed turnover calendar as a personal win.

title: Full Stack Developer (Must Be Comfortable Using AI Coding Tools)
description:
Hey there!



We're looking for a Full Stack Developer to join our remote team.



We build a variety of web applications, internal systems, business tools, and custom software, so you'll have the opportunity to work on different types of projects instead of maintaining just one application. Every project brings new challenges and opportunities to learn.



If you enjoy solving problems, building scalable software, and working with modern technologies, we'd love to hear from you.



This is a 100% remote, full-time position. We're looking for someone who is dependable, communicates well in English, follows direction well, and can also work independently.







What You'll Be Working On:

- Build and enhance web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, Node.js)

- Develop clean, responsive user interfaces using React and Tailwind CSS

- Build and maintain backend APIs and services

- Integrate third-party APIs, business platforms, and automation tools

- Optimize applications for speed, scalability, and maintainability

- Collaborate with developers, designers, and project managers to deliver high-quality features

AI-Assisted Development (Required)



We expect our developers to use AI coding assistants as part of their daily development workflow to speed up development, debugging, troubleshooting, refactoring, and problem-solving.



You should have experience using one or more of the following:



- ChatGPT

- Claude

- Google Gemini

- GitHub Copilot

- Cursor

- Other AI coding assistants



We're not looking for someone who simply copies and pastes AI-generated code. You should be able to understand, verify, debug, and improve the code you ship.



Our team regularly uses tools like Claude, Cursor, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Vercel, AWS, Zapier, and n8n as part of our development workflow.



Attention to detail matters. If you've read this far, remember the phrase: "Let's go dev!" You'll need to include it in your application.







Skills We're Looking For:

- 2+ years of professional full-stack development experience

- Strong experience with React.js

- Strong backend development using Node.js and Express.js

- Experience with MongoDB, MySQL, or PostgreSQL

- Working knowledge of PHP

- Strong understanding of Git, GitHub, branching strategies, pull requests, and version control best practices

- Experience with GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines

- Experience with AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, etc.)

- Experience deploying and managing applications with Vercel

- Experience integrating third-party APIs and business platforms

- Experience with automation tools such as Zapier, n8n, or similar

- Solid understanding of REST APIs, JWT authentication, and application performance

- Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

- Good written and spoken English

- Able to follow instructions and communicate clearly

- Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team







Bonus Points | Experience with any of the following is a plus:



- Prisma or Sequelize

- Firebase

- Redis

- Docker

- Serverless architecture

- Experience with Go High Level (GHL) or other CRM platforms





Position Details:

- 100% remote, full-time position

- Paid 1-month probationary period

- Opportunity for long-term employment based on performance.





_________________________



To Apply:



Please submit your application with the subject line:



[Your Name] - Full Stack Developer



Your application must include all of the following:



- Your resume

- A 2–5 minute video introducing yourself and your development experience

- Your GitHub, portfolio, or sample projects

- The AI coding tools you regularly use (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor, Copilot, etc.)

- Describe a recent feature or bug you worked on using AI. Which AI tool did you use, how did it help, and what did you have to solve yourself?

- Tell us about one project you're most proud of and why.



Please make sure to follow all of the application instructions above. Incomplete applications or applications that do not follow the instructions will not be considered.



We're looking for someone who enjoys building quality software, embraces modern development practices, and wants to grow with our team. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you!

mbers by phone and
